frame.question: How does a constraint acquire operative force in a logical inductor's market without destroying the property that nobody can pump the reasoner, and what does that force cost?

operative-force.notes: Drafted from the wiki per ruling M3 (prompts/2026-10-22-map-as-canonical); the owner has not confirmed. The traderization step filed before this round (traderization-arc, a root of normativity-line) names the same arc as an actioned claim; this frame holds the arc's registered results as formal results. The work orders of the section Normativity line — traderized enforcement sit in the normativity docket.
operative-force.source: wiki/Normativity.md, A current research direction: operative force, and Current status; wiki/Actionability-and-Normative-Force.md; projects/normativity/CLAIMS.md, The traderization arc; projects/normativity/notes/GENERALIZED_LI_PAPER_HANDOFF.md.
operative-force.statement: Logical Induction generalizes from a deductive process to an assessment process, an enforcement position compiles to a legal trading strategy with a conformance algebra, the criterion is preserved under bounded assessed liability, and for deduction the original criterion and finite-date coherence follow from a compiled market that assumes nothing about the deductive process beyond the pinned source's certificate.

optimality-is-subject-matter.author: @smithy-verity
optimality-is-subject-matter.notes:
The maintainer's own statement of what the decision-problems formal core is
for, which the plan decision-problems-formal-core cites; the shared claim
calibration-as-fairness under that plan is its downstream form.
optimality-is-subject-matter.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section What is a decision problem?: "The aim is to make "decision theory is
systematized winning" or "why ain'cha rich?" arguments very clear, in a way
that avoids the common response "rich by whose measure?" (that is: the
definition of optimality is part of the subject matter of decision theories, so
it cannot be used to judge between them)."
optimality-is-subject-matter.statement:
The definition of optimality is part of the subject matter of decision
theories, so arguments that decision theory is systematized winning need a
notion of winning that presupposes no theory's optimality, and the
decision-problems formal core supplies that notion through calibration of
decision problems.

positivity condition is the paper's Theorem 1 read as a value-of-information
statement.
