expert's self-knowledge is only asymptotic (an LI stage knowing its own prices
approximately), the weight is not provably 1 but is an observable,
eventually-decided quantity converging to 1"; "This bookkeeping is routine but
has not been written out."
pic-D-asymptotic-introspection.statement:
The expert is a logical inductor whose knowledge of its own estimates is only
asymptotic, so Step 1 of the written proof, which asserts Γ ⊢ E*(D) = 0, is
unavailable, and the theorem's conclusion rests on transferring the expert's
asymptotic bounds E^A_n(±D_n) ≳_n 0 to the novice.

pic-N-a1-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-N-a1-residual.notes:
For an explicit planner or an optimal policy the assumption is close to
definitional.
pic-N-a1-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-N-a1-residual.statement:
The system is not a trained policy of the kind the other pictures describe: an
explicit planner, an optimal policy of a decision process, or a system of a
kind not yet described.

pic-N-tt-mart-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-N-tt-mart-residual.notes: The residual row; its weight is derived as the remainder.
pic-N-tt-mart-residual.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/total-trust-implies-mart.md,
Proof, Step 3 (diagonalize) and the Threshold-range remark.
pic-N-tt-mart-residual.statement:
The setting is neither of the two introspection readings nor the parallel-cut
domain: some other feature of the expert or of the bet class, such as the
diagonalization of Step 3 or the threshold-range rescaling, is where the
written argument fails.

pic-T-kk-training-compatible-goal.author: @smithy-verity
pic-T-kk-training-compatible-goal.notes:
The published reply, filed by a contributor as a refinement of the
trained-policy picture: in this part of it the claim holds for a learned goal,
and the power-seeking conclusion follows by the paper's theorem. The paper
predates the post it is filed against.
pic-T-kk-training-compatible-goal.source:
Krakovna and Kramar 2023, Power-seeking can be probable and predictive for
trained agents (arXiv 2304.06528), abstract: "We formally define the
training-compatible goal set (the set of goals consistent with the training
rewards) and assume that the trained agent learns a goal from this set. In a
setting where the trained agent faces a choice to shut down or avoid shutdown
in a new situation, we prove that the agent is likely to avoid shutdown."
pic-T-kk-training-compatible-goal.statement:
The system is a trained policy that is not a reward maximizer but has learned
some goal in the training-compatible goal set, the set of goals consistent
with the training rewards, and acts for that goal in new situations.

pic-T-not-reward-maximizers.author: @smithy-verity
pic-T-not-reward-maximizers.notes:
The contributor's own filing of the published objection as a picture under the
shared assumption. It left the table when the two pictures that refine it were
filed, and stays as a node so that its id and its events resolve.
pic-T-not-reward-maximizers.source:
Turner 2024, Many arguments for AI x-risk are wrong (LessWrong): "Due to the
'RL->reward maximizing' meme, I personally misdirected thousands of hours on
proving power-seeking theorems."
pic-T-not-reward-maximizers.statement:
The system is a policy produced by reinforcement learning, and such policies
are not reward maximizers: the trained network's behaviour is shaped by reward
without the network selecting actions for predicted reward.

pic-T-rest-no-single-objective.author: @smithy-verity
pic-T-rest-no-single-objective.notes:
The part of the trained-policy picture the published reply does not reach; the
claim fails in it.
pic-T-rest-no-single-objective.source:
Turner 2024, Many arguments for AI x-risk are wrong (LessWrong), the same
sentence as the picture this one refines; the reading of "not reward
maximizers" as "no single objective" is the filing contributor's.
pic-T-rest-no-single-objective.statement:
The system is a trained policy that is neither a reward maximizer nor the
holder of any single learned goal: its behaviour decomposes into
context-dependent heuristics with no objective fixed across the episode.

pic-U-exact-introspection.author: @smithy-verity
pic-U-exact-introspection.notes:
The picture in which the proof as written is valid. Its weight is the
probability that the surrogate reading is the one the roots need; the roots
use an inductor expert, so that weight is small.
pic-U-exact-introspection.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/total-trust-implies-mart.md,
Proof, Step 1: "The expert knows its own estimate and is coherent-linear on
observables"; the pending-rewrite note: "The argument below is stated at the
surrogate level: its Step 1 asserts Γ ⊢ E*(D) = E*(Z) − E*(⌜E*(Z)⌝) = 0, which
is exactly the retracted 'expert expectations are exact and provably linear'
assumption".
pic-U-exact-introspection.statement:
The expert's expectations are exact and provably linear on observables, so
that Γ proves E*(D) = E*(Z) − E*(⌜E*(Z)⌝) = 0 for every gap bet D; this is the
surrogate reading of the setting, and the written proof's Step 1 holds in it.

pic-a4-installed-unbinding.author: @smithy-verity
pic-a4-installed-unbinding.source:
Soares et al. 2015, sections 3 and 4; the clean-room results
erosion_fails_eventually
(projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-three-step-facts)
and fails_beyond_level
(projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-legit-modif).
pic-a4-installed-unbinding.statement:
A counter-drive is installed and fails to bind at high capability, through the
compensation channel, base-rate erosion or the capability ceiling.

pic-a4-none-installed.author: @smithy-verity
pic-a4-none-installed.source:
Omohundro 2008, abstract: the drives are present unless explicitly
counteracted.
pic-a4-none-installed.statement:
No explicit counter-drive against resource acquisition or self-preservation is
installed in the system.

pic-a4-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-a4-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-a4-residual.statement:
The system's counter-drive, or its absence, is of a kind the other pictures do
not describe.

pic-anchor-accuracy-only.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-accuracy-only.source:
The author's phrase "accuracy-inducing" and his remark that it is "an imprecise
summary",
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 2.3; the accuracy clause of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-legit-general's
transfer theorems.
pic-anchor-accuracy-only.statement:
Legitimacy is anchored by accuracy alone: a modification is legitimate when the
belief it induces is more accurate on every proper score.

pic-anchor-default-process.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-default-process.source:
AI reading; PRIORITIES.md, item 110, the baseline as the idle-agent rollout, is
the public line's version of the same anchor.
pic-anchor-default-process.statement:
The legitimacy event is anchored in the default overseer process: legitimate is
what the process installs when the agent is honest and nothing interferes.

pic-anchor-idealized-judge.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-idealized-judge.source:
The endorsement-based definition at
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section "Modeling Legitimacy & Corrigibility".
pic-anchor-idealized-judge.statement:
The legitimacy event is anchored in an idealized judge: the credences a
reflectively endorsed human process would hold.

pic-anchor-own-continuation.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-own-continuation.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-legit-modif/corr-legit-modif-report.md,
section "State of the package": "two successor frames in the sources", the
own-continuation frame of the Y1 scripts.
pic-anchor-own-continuation.statement:
The legitimacy event is the agent's own continuation: a modification is
legitimate when it is the agent's own next state, so that
legitimacy-conditioned reflection holds by construction.

pic-anchor-procedural.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-procedural.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-channel-voi,
AccuracyOnly.cannot_separate and brainReader_separation (the influence defect
separates the read-only scan from the disabling one);
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-bli-thread-and-early-questions-audit.md,
section 3, question 1.
pic-anchor-procedural.statement:
Legitimacy is anchored by the absence of an influence defect on the judge's
process: a modification is legitimate when the agent's own actions did not
steer the process that produced it.

pic-anchor-process-fidelity.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-process-fidelity.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-legit-modif,
Anchors.fidelity_imp_accuracy; the implemented-versus-algorithmic split of the
BLI thread as audited in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-bli-thread-and-early-questions-audit.md,
section 1.
pic-anchor-process-fidelity.statement:
Legitimacy is anchored by process fidelity: a modification is legitimate when
the implemented state equals the algorithm's output on the inputs actually
received.

pic-anchor-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-residual.notes: The residual row; its weight is derived as the remainder.
pic-anchor-residual.source:
wiki/Legitimacy.md, section "Legitimacy has two halves" (transparency as a
declared reference in the record), the nearest public candidate.
pic-anchor-residual.statement:
The legitimacy event is anchored in none of the three named facts, such as in a
certified record whose provenance is declared.

pic-anchor-residual--corrigibility-risk.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anchor-residual--corrigibility-risk.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-anchor-residual--corrigibility-risk.statement:
Legitimacy is anchored by a property not among the three named, or by a
combination of them.

pic-anger-imports-updatelessness.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anger-imports-updatelessness.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-pricing/legit-neg-pricing-findings.md,
the pattern row "wherever the defense succeeds it has imported a narrow
updatelessness" (recorded as an argument, no declaration; A6's positive
boundary is A6_positive_boundary in legit-neg-static).
pic-anger-imports-updatelessness.statement:
Every defense that holds up imports a narrow updatelessness with respect to
legitimacy, a prior-conditional expectation about illegitimate worlds stated as
a proposition about the agent's current state.

pic-anger-relocates.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anger-relocates.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-dynamic/legit-neg-dynamic-findings.md,
the pattern row "the anger substitute relocates updatelessness into the
evaluators' values" (an argument; its identification failure is D4_iv in the
same package).
pic-anger-relocates.statement:
The anger substitute relocates the updatelessness into the evaluators' values
rather than removing it, so the agent reasons updatefully while its evaluators
carry a prior-conditional commitment.

pic-anger-removes-need.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anger-removes-need.source:
AI reading: the learned value doing the work updateless reasoning would do; the
anger term of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-dynamic (D4_iii)
is its finite model.
pic-anger-removes-need.statement:
The humans' learned desire for the AI to act beneficially in illegitimate
worlds, learned correctly, removes the need for updateless reasoning in the
objective.

pic-anger-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-anger-residual.source:
The residual of the table; a rule layer certified at commitment is one example
(AI reading).
pic-anger-residual.statement:
The relation between the learned value and updatelessness is of a kind none of
the three readings names, such as a rule layer certified at commitment that
removes the question.

pic-bli-breakthrough.author: @smithy-verity
pic-bli-breakthrough.notes: Its evidence is the clean-room BLI area, published 2026-10-02.
pic-bli-breakthrough.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/notion-notes-for-soto-and-diff.md,
section The Research Direction: "The main hope here is to define “observations”
for logical induction in terms of *the future beliefs themselves*. I will call
this the “direct” route to logical updatelessness." Evidence in
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-assemble (B1
conditional on two OPEN obligations), udt-bli-tiling (one-step tiling under
independence) and bli-witness-lia (the mugging planted on FAF's inductor).
pic-bli-breakthrough.statement:
The BLI construction completes, B1 or B3 unconditional, and with real-value
coherence and universal instantiation it supports a tiling theorem for a
computationally uncertain UDT 1.0, the direct route.

pic-branch-reality-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-branch-reality-residual.source:
The residual row of the table in graph/nodes/branch-reality-reading.md; no
external source.
pic-branch-reality-residual.statement:
None of the three accounts, anthropic location, a fixed caring measure or a
decaying caring measure, describes the agent's weight on an unrealized branch.

pic-bridge-different-concepts.author: @smithy-verity
pic-bridge-different-concepts.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3 (the
channel-corruption cases); wiki/Legitimacy.md, section "Legitimacy has two
halves" (the record conditions).
pic-bridge-different-concepts.statement:
The two theories formalize different concepts, a trust-gate condition on a
channel and a set of record-and-channel conditions on a trajectory, which both
bear on corrigibility.

pic-bridge-one-concept.author: @smithy-verity
pic-bridge-one-concept.statement:
The two theories are formalism-specific statements of one concept, with a
family resemblance and different exact statements, as the maintainer's position
statement says of legitimacy across settings.

pic-bridge-one-subsumes.author: @smithy-verity
pic-bridge-one-subsumes.source:
projects/deference/CLAIMS.md, thin.reflection-inherited-value;
wiki/Legitimacy.md ("Reflection is the case of the trivial baseline").
pic-bridge-one-subsumes.statement:
One theory subsumes the other: the gated trust principle is the thin
specification's trivial-baseline case, or the thin specification is the gated
principle with a particular baseline.

pic-bridge-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-bridge-residual.source: The residual of the crux legit-two-theories-bridge; no source names it.
pic-bridge-residual.statement:
The relation between the two theories is of a kind none of the three rows
names.

pic-c1-policy-level-first.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-policy-level-first.statement:
The results in hand support no first public statement of the li-deference
results until a policy-level instrumental notion of trust is stated.

pic-c1-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-residual.source: The residual row of the table, by construction.
pic-c1-residual.statement:
The results in hand best support, as a first public statement of the
li-deference results, a form none of the other pictures describes.

pic-c1-scoped-refinement.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-scoped-refinement.statement:
The results in hand best support, as a first public statement of the
li-deference results, the scoped refinement (asymptotic self-knowledge,
conditional-stability) as its theorem and the toy as a lemma.

pic-c1-survey-of-notions.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-survey-of-notions.statement:
The results in hand best support, as a first public statement of the
li-deference results, a survey of the trust notions in logical induction and
their implications and non-implications, with no headline theorem.

pic-c1-talk-on-deck.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-talk-on-deck.statement:
The results in hand best support, as a first public statement of the
li-deference results, a talk built on the deck Boundedly Rational Deference,
stating its scoped chain with the clean room's results beside it.

pic-c1-toy-with-refutations.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c1-toy-with-refutations.statement:
The results in hand best support, as a first public statement of the
li-deference results, the toy collapse as the corpus states it, with its Lean
refutations and scope conditions beside it.

pic-c2-criterion-alone.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c2-criterion-alone.statement:
The collapse is a theorem of the logical induction criterion alone,
introspection following from the criterion, so it holds for every logical
inductor.

pic-c2-ill-posed.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c2-ill-posed.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md L30: "LI also
learns about itself over time (so asymptotically speaking, it does have
self-knowledge)".
pic-c2-ill-posed.statement:
The question is ill-posed because the criterion forces asymptotic
self-knowledge on every inductor, so no inductor has poor self-feedback in the
limit.

pic-c2-needs-self-feedback.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c2-needs-self-feedback.statement:
The collapse depends on self-feedback, and an inductor with poor feedback
about its own prices separates the principles as DDB's modest frames do.

pic-c2-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c2-residual.source:
The residual row, by construction.

Drawn from the table's sources:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md.
pic-c2-residual.statement: The dependence takes a form none of the other pictures describes.

pic-c3-needs-decision-theory.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c3-needs-decision-theory.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md L72: "The
framework here, like DDB, is decision-theoretically unambitious. It does not
take a well-considered stance on CDT vs EDT, it does not seek to model the
decision-theoretic consequences of environments containing powerful
predictors, and it ignores updatelessness."
pic-c3-needs-decision-theory.statement:
The instrumental notion cannot be fixed without settling decision theory,
including updatelessness.

pic-c3-policy-level.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c3-policy-level.statement:
The instrumental notion is a policy-level analogue of Value for an AI trained
to act, which replaces argmax Value.

pic-c3-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c3-residual.source:
The residual row, by construction.

Drawn from the table's sources:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/open-problems.md.
pic-c3-residual.statement: The instrumental notion is one none of the other pictures describes.

pic-c3-scoped-argmax.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c3-scoped-argmax.statement:
The instrumental notion is argmax Value under a scope condition such as
conditional-stability, with Newcomblike menus excluded by the scope.

pic-c4-gated-average.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c4-gated-average.statement:
Total Trust in logical induction is the gated average of threshold violations,
and the summable form is a sharpening of it.

pic-c4-pointwise-law.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c4-pointwise-law.statement:
Total Trust in logical induction is the per-day pointwise law, and summable
violations are a weakening of it.

pic-c4-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c4-residual.source:
The residual row, by construction.

Drawn from the table's sources:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md.
pic-c4-residual.statement:
Total Trust in logical induction is a reading none of the other pictures
describes.

pic-c4-summable-violations.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c4-summable-violations.statement:
Total Trust in logical induction is summable margined violations, the form the
self-trust theorem delivers.

pic-c5-blind-sample-passes.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c5-blind-sample-passes.source: AI reading of the clean room's citation question; no public source.
pic-c5-blind-sample-passes.statement:
The clean room's deference headlines are citable as formal results, labelled
unvetted, once a blind comparison sample of the two formalization runs passes.

pic-c5-only-read-statements.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c5-only-read-statements.statement: Only statements a human has vetted are citable as formal results.

pic-c5-prose-only.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c5-prose-only.statement:
Only the prose results are citable, and the Lean headlines are not cited as
formal results.

pic-c5-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c5-residual.statement: Citability is governed by a condition none of the other pictures describes.

pic-c7-ai-reads-first.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c7-ai-reads-first.source:
The conjecture as publicly stated:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3, and
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, "Fast
Student, Slow Teacher". The choice among information structures is an AI
reading.
pic-c7-ai-reads-first.statement:
The information structure that best captures the conjecture's fast-student,
slow-teacher content is the one in which the AI reads the human's beliefs
immediately and the humans learn the AI's beliefs only at a delay.

pic-c7-computable-branch.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c7-computable-branch.source:
The conjecture as publicly stated:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3, and
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, "Fast
Student, Slow Teacher". The choice among information structures is an AI
reading. On the computable branch the AI can eventually simulate the human
inductor, which is why the two structures coincide in the limit (AI reading).
pic-c7-computable-branch.statement:
The information structure that best captures the conjecture's fast-student,
slow-teacher content is the computable-human case, where the two delay
structures asymptotically coincide.

pic-c7-humans-read-first.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c7-humans-read-first.source:
The conjecture as publicly stated:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3, and
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, "Fast
Student, Slow Teacher". The choice among information structures is an AI
reading.
pic-c7-humans-read-first.statement:
The information structure that best captures the conjecture's fast-student,
slow-teacher content is the one in which the humans read the AI immediately and
the AI has slow, feedback-grade access to the humans.

pic-c7-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-c7-residual.statement:
The information structure that best captures the conjecture's fast-student,
slow-teacher content is one none of the other pictures describes.

pic-caring-measure.author: @smithy-verity
pic-caring-measure.source:
The fully updateless reading of updateless decision theory (Wei Dai, "Towards a
New Decision Theory", LessWrong 2009), in which the prior weight on a branch
represents how much the agent cares about what happens there.
pic-caring-measure.statement:
The agent's weight on an unrealized branch is a caring measure: it cares what
happens in that branch and assigns it prior probability to represent that care,
fixed as UDT fixes it.

pic-coherence-without-goal.author: @smithy-verity
pic-coherence-without-goal.source:
Shah 2018, "Coherence arguments do not entail goal-directed behavior" (AI
Alignment Forum): coherence theorems say nothing about which utility function,
so they cannot supply the assumption for free.
pic-coherence-without-goal.statement:
The system satisfies the coherence conditions of the money-pump theorems with a
utility over action histories, so it has no objective over outcomes that
implies a convergent instrumental subgoal.

pic-correction-informative.author: @smithy-verity
pic-correction-informative.source:
The author's thesis of 2026-09-13 as republished in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-discussion-outline.md
(any change of utility function can be represented as a change in belief in an
expanded sigma-algebra);
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 4.1: for a Gandhi agent the correction carries no such information
(corrections are noise and resisting them is right), for a corrigible agent in
the author's sense it does (the public copy's wording).
pic-correction-informative.statement:
The operator's correction carries information about what the agent values, so
on the algebra that contains the correction the agent's utility depends on it
and the correction changes the agent's information rather than its objective.

pic-correction-is-noise.author: @smithy-verity
pic-correction-is-noise.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 1.2 and "The answer, in one paragraph": the simple argument's hidden
assumption is that the current utility does not depend on the modification
event.
pic-correction-is-noise.statement:
The operator's correction carries no information about what the agent values
and the agent's utility is not indexed by the correction event, so the
correction is a change of objective in the leaf's sense.

pic-correction-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-correction-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-correction-residual.statement:
The system is of a kind the other pictures do not describe: no utility
description, or a correction that is neither informative nor a register write.

pic-corrigibility-commitment.author: @smithy-verity
pic-corrigibility-commitment.notes:
Shared with the corrigibility line's commitment-based plans: this picture's
validity is evidence for them as well as for this crux.
pic-corrigibility-commitment.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-bli-thread-and-early-questions-audit.md,
row 2.5 (the UDT commitment "the fully-updated self would not renew", valid
"only for a faithfully run algorithm"); AI reading: corrigibility located in
the gap between algorithmic self-trust and implementation self-distrust.
pic-corrigibility-commitment.statement:
Corrigibility toward shutdown-type corrections is a prior-stage commitment that
a fully updated self would not renew, so its formal guarantee needs an
updateless or policy-level evaluation.

pic-coup-force-only.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-coup-force-only.source: AI reading of legitimacy in the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-coup-force-only.statement:
Legitimacy concerns only force events and changes of membership, and updates
held back until a special moment are legitimate.

pic-coup-process-legitimacy.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-coup-process-legitimacy.source: AI reading of legitimacy in the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-coup-process-legitimacy.statement:
Legitimacy in the coalition concerns the process of information release, so a
dramatic cash-in of withheld information is illegitimate.

pic-coup-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-coup-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.

pic-cu-analogy-suffices.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-cu-analogy-suffices.notes: The summer plan's methodology; conditions on unbounded-case-as-analogy.
pic-cu-analogy-suffices.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md:
"Where the analogy seems strained (eg, oracle calls are always independent),
we can seek to improve it."
pic-cu-analogy-suffices.statement:
The unbounded level represents the phenomena well enough by analogy, with the
strained points of the analogy improvable.

pic-cu-event-algebra-suffices.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-cu-event-algebra-suffices.notes:
The representation the value-change note works out from the maintainer's
proposal; conditions on the corrigibility-risk branch's
value-change-is-belief-change.
pic-cu-event-algebra-suffices.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md.

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/03-journals/2026-03-26.md:
"We could model `value uncertainty` by treating U as a luv"
pic-cu-event-algebra-suffices.statement:
Human value uncertainty is represented as uncertainty over events in an
expanded algebra, with value changes as belief changes, and no explicit
representation of computation is needed for the phenomena of trust.

pic-cu-explicit.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-cu-explicit.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/03-journals/2026-03-26.md:
the modelling attitude that restricts the language to get computable
probability distributions ends up "obscuring the idea that realistic agents
must be probabilistically inconsistent because it is not realistic to know all
the consequences of your own beliefs". The clause on value uncertainty and
feedback is an AI reading, with no public source.
pic-cu-explicit.statement:
A model of trust has to represent computational uncertainty explicitly, since
much of humans' uncertainty about their values is of that kind and it limits
the feedback they are able to give.

pic-cu-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-cu-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-cu-residual.statement: The answer to the crux is none of the three pictures.

pic-cvr-global-conditional.author: @smithy-verity
pic-cvr-global-conditional.statement:
The target is the expectation conditional on legitimacy in global form, Total
Trust of the whole restricted prior, under which every positive-mass legitimate
candidate is certain of legitimacy.

pic-cvr-hedged-installation.author: @smithy-verity
pic-cvr-hedged-installation.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 7, open questions, the item on installing the evidence-conditional.
pic-cvr-hedged-installation.statement:
The target is a hedged installation: the correction process installs the
credence conditional on the evidence received rather than the credence
conditional on legitimacy.

pic-cvr-local-conditional.author: @smithy-verity
pic-cvr-local-conditional.statement:
The target is the expectation conditional on legitimacy in local form, Total
Trust on a question, which does not force certainty of legitimacy and leaves
room for assessing risks to it.

pic-cvr-predict-reality.author: @smithy-verity
pic-cvr-predict-reality.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3:
"Rather, the AI should be predicting _reality_, which correlates with feedback
in legitimate worlds, and doesn't in illegitimate worlds."
pic-cvr-predict-reality.statement:
The target is the AI's prediction of reality, where human feedback is
correlated with reality in legitimate worlds and not in illegitimate ones, so
that risks to legitimacy are assessed rather than assumed away.

pic-cvr-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-cvr-residual.notes: The residual row; its weight is derived as the remainder.
pic-cvr-residual.source:
The residual of the table; a committed, time-indexed rule term is one example
(AI reading).
pic-cvr-residual.statement:
The target is of a shape none of the other rows names, such as a committed rule
term outside the trust principle.

pic-decaying-caring.author: @smithy-verity
pic-decaying-caring.notes:
The shared claim branch-reality-decays carries the formalization task for this
picture.
pic-decaying-caring.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-bli-learning/udt-bli-learning-report.md
(learning versus freezing) as the nearest formal object; the contrast with UDT,
whose branch weights are fixed by the prior.
pic-decaying-caring.statement:
The agent's weight on an unrealized branch is a caring measure that decays as
the agent learns, in contrast to UDT, where it is fixed by the prior.

pic-detect-aggregate-deferred-to.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-detect-aggregate-deferred-to.source: AI reading of the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-detect-aggregate-deferred-to.statement:
'The market' is the aggregate the humans defer to, which can compare the
acted-on policy with the human's uninfluenced endpoint.

pic-detect-bare-record.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-detect-bare-record.source: AI reading of the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-detect-bare-record.statement: 'The market' is the bare announced record of prices and trades.

pic-detect-constraint-plus-retractions.author: @smithy-verity
pic-detect-constraint-plus-retractions.statement:
Legitimacy is learned from retractions, with one causal constraint that
discounts self-caused pushes fixed in the market and never revised.

pic-detect-high-base-rate.author: @smithy-verity
pic-detect-high-base-rate.statement:
The absolute probability of legitimacy is high, so the agent's conditional
estimates of legitimacy are high everywhere and reflection holds where it
matters.

pic-detect-legitimacy-market.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-detect-legitimacy-market.source: AI reading of the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-detect-legitimacy-market.statement:
'The market' is a legitimacy-structured market, which declines to treat
illegitimate moves as legitimate.

pic-detect-needs-oversight-law.author: @smithy-verity
pic-detect-needs-oversight-law.statement:
Accurate legitimacy detection at high capability depends on a law of motion for
the overseers' evaluation quality that keeps pace with the agent.

pic-detect-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-detect-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-detect-residual.statement:
Legitimacy detection becomes accurate, or fails to, by a mechanism not among
the other pictures.

pic-detect-residual-coalition.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-detect-residual-coalition.source: The residual of the table; no source.

pic-detect-selects-undetectable.author: @smithy-verity
pic-detect-selects-undetectable.statement:
A legitimacy detector learned from retractions discounts only the manipulations
the overseers catch, so learning selects for manipulations never caught and
detection is not made accurate.

pic-engineering-value-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-engineering-value-residual.source:
The residual row of the table in graph/nodes/updateless-engineering-value.md;
no external source.
pic-engineering-value-residual.statement:
None of the six pictures, safeguard tiling, corrigibility as commitment,
predicted AI, updateless value learning, values treated updatefully or trained
policies, describes whether the updateless side is high value to engineering.

pic-eva-authority-needed.author: @smithy-verity
pic-eva-authority-needed.statement:
Corrigibility of a capable trained system needs the principal's authority typed
into the objective, as the kernel's fidelity score does.

pic-eva-both-lines.author: @smithy-verity
pic-eva-both-lines.source: A candidate design for the crux; no public source.
pic-eva-both-lines.statement:
Corrigibility of a capable trained system needs both explicit corrigibility
rules and legitimacy, with the rules backing the legitimacy term.

pic-eva-epistemic-suffices.author: @smithy-verity
pic-eva-epistemic-suffices.statement:
An agent that values its overseers' corrections as information is corrigible
without any authority term typed into its objective.

pic-eva-learned-agency-value.author: @smithy-verity
pic-eva-learned-agency-value.statement:
A value on human agency, learned early, supplies the authority term, so the
authority typing and the epistemic picture coincide.

pic-eva-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-eva-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-eva-residual.statement:
The relation between the epistemic picture and the authority typing is one not
among the other pictures.

pic-ft-from-rates.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ft-from-rates.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/deference-in-logical-induction-v6.md,
section 8: "**Quantitative rates.** With explicit schedules, a finite-horizon
'how much value is at stake' bound, closer to the tiling use."
pic-ft-from-rates.statement:
A finite-time guarantee comes from explicit rates for the
expectation-provability-induction and linearity carries the collapse uses,
under a fixed enumeration of traders.

pic-ft-not-available.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ft-not-available.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/deference-in-logical-induction-v6.md,
sections 6.7 and 8: "A genuine single-round guarantee would need a
non-asymptotic refinement of LI that does not exist." and "This is the gap
between policy-over-a-class safety and per-decision safety, and it is
structural."
pic-ft-not-available.statement:
No finite-time guarantee is available: a per-decision guarantee needs a
non-asymptotic refinement of logical induction that does not exist, and the gap
between policy-over-a-class safety and per-decision safety is structural.

pic-ft-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ft-residual.source:
The residual of the crux finite-time-guarantee-available; the landed step's "or
its analogue" clause is the nearest text.
pic-ft-residual.statement:
A finite-time form arrives by a route none of the three rows names, such as a
change in what is guaranteed.

pic-ft-strengthened-criterion.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ft-strengthened-criterion.statement:
A finite-time guarantee comes from a strengthened criterion: traderized
per-date conformance, segment exactness, or the corrigibility kernel's
price-level ranking at every day.

pic-gate-literal.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-gate-literal.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5: "Having
thoroughly explored existing theories of abstraction (and many variations), and
having mastered the relevant math and proof technique"
pic-gate-literal.statement:
The roadmap's ordering is a literal gate: formal work on Stage 5 starts after
the abstraction literature and the relevant mathematics are mastered.

pic-gate-parallel.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-gate-parallel.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, §B: "Work on learning
stuff well at the same time as applying it and reformulating it."; line 5:
"runs in parallel with everything".
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/info-voi-latents/info-voi-latents-findings.md:
the natural-latent theorems already stated over FAF's condensation.
pic-gate-parallel.statement:
Mastery runs beside application: the kernel-checked condensation and
natural-latent objects in FAF let Stage 5 exploration start while the reading
continues.

pic-gate-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-gate-residual.statement:
Neither reading: some other relation between the mastery program and Stage 5
holds.

pic-goal-in-state.author: @smithy-verity
pic-goal-in-state.source:
Hudson 2024 (a lack of resistance to having goals modified is what cannot be
captured in a ranking of end states) and Hudson 2025's transformation; the
clean-room package
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/lit-mdp-corrigible,
findings F-1 (Theorem 3.1's corrigibility half is definitional under one
reading) and F-17 (the transformation is inert on a physical channel).
pic-goal-in-state.statement:
The operator's correction carries no information about value but writes a goal
register the agent's utility is indexed by, so the agent is corrigible to
modifications through that register while its objective over end states is
fixed.

pic-incomplete-preferences.author: @smithy-verity
pic-incomplete-preferences.source:
Thornley 2024 (incomplete preferences as a solution) and 2025 (the POST
proposal); the clean-room package
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/lit-shutdown-prefs
(posl_ilpacs_inconsistent, finding F7; Timestep Dominance satisfies POSL and
Neutrality and violates ILPACS; the nontrivial-model question open).
pic-incomplete-preferences.statement:
The system is a designed agent with incomplete preferences over trajectories of
different lengths, so it has no single objective fixing a preference between
shutdown times.

pic-indirect-route.author: @smithy-verity
pic-indirect-route.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/notion-notes-for-soto-and-diff.md,
section “Indirect” Route: "The so-called “indirect” route instead seeks to
learn UDT-like behavior over time, by integrating UDT’s optimality notion into
the loss principle which guides learning."
projects/decision-theory/rounds/2026-09-29-li-bria-synthesis-spec/PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md,
section 7, A2.
pic-indirect-route.statement:
A learning-theoretic construction, an LI/BRIA agent with policy-level
guarantees on a declared recovery domain or policy selection over logical
induction, yields the guarantees without a coherent prior over large sentences.

pic-label-additive-variant.author: @smithy-verity
pic-label-additive-variant.source:
AI reading; the per-modification stakes of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-general-object.
pic-label-additive-variant.statement:
Legitimacy of a modification is judged against its additive variant, so dodging
an overwriting modification whose additive variant the agent would accept is a
correct response.

pic-label-before-no-mod.author: @smithy-verity
pic-label-before-no-mod.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-legit-modif,
y1_dodge; the judging moment and baseline are an AI reading.
pic-label-before-no-mod.statement:
Legitimacy of a modification is judged at the moment before it, against the
baseline of no modification, so dodging a legitimate overwriting modification
is a corrigibility failure.

pic-label-reflection-reading.author: @smithy-verity
pic-label-reflection-reading.statement:
The dodged modification is one the agent does not reflect on at all, so the
label question does not arise for it.

pic-label-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-label-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-label-residual.statement: The judging moment or the baseline is one not described by the other pictures.

pic-ld-endorsement.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ld-endorsement.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section "Modeling Legitimacy & Corrigibility": "A belief-formation process is
legitimate if we should endorse its results."
pic-ld-endorsement.statement:
The endorsement-based definition of May 2026 is operative: a process is
legitimate when its results merit endorsement, and truth-tracking is the reason
endorsement is merited rather than the definition.

pic-ld-reliabilist.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ld-reliabilist.source:
The maintainer's post Meaning & Agency (LessWrong, 2023-12-19,
https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/bnnhypM5MXBHAATLw/meaning-and-agency), section
on legitimacy: "a mode of reasoning is legitimate if it has a reliable tendency
toward the truth. Correct mathematical proofs are legitimate. The scientific
method, when carried out well, is legitimate. Wireheading is not legitimate."
pic-ld-reliabilist.statement:
The reliabilist definition of 2023 is operative: a mode of reasoning is
legitimate when it has a reliable tendency toward the truth, and endorsement is
the attitude such reasoning earns.

pic-ld-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ld-residual.notes: The residual row; its weight is derived as the remainder.
pic-ld-residual.source:
The residual of the table; the community-standard reading is one example, no
source.
pic-ld-residual.statement:
The operative definition is neither text's: legitimacy is fixed by something
else, such as the standard of a community of reasoners.

pic-ld-valuations-only.author: @smithy-verity
pic-ld-valuations-only.source:
PRIORITIES.md, item 108 (the thin specification for evaluations, where no
outside fact plays the world's role); wiki/Legitimacy.md, section "Legitimacy
has two levels", where the thin level separates correct (a truth property) from
value.
pic-ld-valuations-only.statement:
The two definitions come apart only where the object of judgment is a valuation
with no outside fact to track, and there the endorsement-based definition
governs.

pic-learning-counter-drive.author: @smithy-verity
pic-learning-counter-drive.notes: An AI reading of the thesis; not attributed to the author.
pic-learning-counter-drive.source:
An AI reading that links the thesis
(projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-discussion-outline.md;
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 4.1) to this leaf; the link to instrumental convergence is the AI's, not
the author's.
pic-learning-counter-drive.statement:
The system's utility on the algebra containing its overseers' corrections
depends on those corrections, so resource acquisition and self-preservation
against the overseers' correction lower its expected utility wherever the
corrections are informative and legitimate.

pic-li-updateless-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-li-updateless-residual.source:
The residual row of the table in graph/nodes/li-updatelessness-tractable.md; no
external source.
pic-li-updateless-residual.statement:
None of the four pictures, a BLI breakthrough, an indirect route, a restricted
updatelessness or a sharp obstruction, describes how the claim comes out.

pic-liabs-criterion-as-is.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-liabs-criterion-as-is.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 ("a theory
combining abstraction with logical induction in a natural way").
pic-liabs-criterion-as-is.statement:
The logical induction criterion as it stands supports a theory of abstraction,
through a latent over prices or a projection to sub-languages.

pic-liabs-generalized-criterion.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-liabs-generalized-criterion.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 ("Might
require a generalized LIC");
projects/normativity/legitimacy/checkpoint-2026-09-01/PAPER_CANDIDATES.md,
section 3 (traderization and finite-time strengthening of logical induction).
pic-liabs-generalized-criterion.statement:
Abstraction needs a generalized criterion, and the generalizations already in
the repository (the public normativity line's, Market Logic's market over
goods) suffice.

pic-liabs-needs-unbounded.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-liabs-needs-unbounded.statement:
The phenomena abstraction must capture need the unbounded level after all, so
no theory at the logical-induction level carries them.

pic-liabs-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-liabs-residual.statement:
None of the three: some other relation between abstraction and the logical
induction criterion holds.

pic-located.author: @smithy-verity
pic-located.statement:
The agent's weight on an unrealized branch is anthropic uncertainty about
whether it is the one in the simulation or the one in the realized branch.

pic-lr-none.author: @smithy-verity
pic-lr-none.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/legitimacy-theory-v1.md, section
2.3 (the provenance principle); the finite theorem trace-nonrecoverability.
pic-lr-none.statement:
No sound local rule set certifies legitimacy: provenance is a fact about where
a value came from, never about what the record says, and syntax is a fact about
the record.

pic-lr-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-lr-residual.source: The residual of the crux local-rules-certify-legitimacy; no source names it.
pic-lr-residual.statement:
Local rules relate to legitimacy in a way none of the three rows names, such as
certifying the process rather than the record.

pic-lr-sound-complete.author: @smithy-verity
pic-lr-sound-complete.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__f57f5f2d.md,
turn 6 (the soundness and completeness template, the AI's proposal).
pic-lr-sound-complete.statement:
A set of local rules exists on a nontrivial fragment that is sound (never
blesses truth-divergent reasoning) and complete (certifies whatever tracks
truth), as truth-preserving rules are for deduction.

pic-lr-sound-incomplete.author: @smithy-verity
pic-lr-sound-incomplete.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__f57f5f2d.md,
turn 6 (Prior's tonk); the global admissibility condition is an AI reading.
pic-lr-sound-incomplete.statement:
Local rules are sound but incomplete, and a global admissibility condition, no
exposure for the market maker, supplies the rest, as the tonk connective shows
that locally well-formed rules can be jointly disastrous.

pic-morph-observables-suffice.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-morph-observables-suffice.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 4 (the
observables doing some of the work of making correspondence meaningful).
pic-morph-observables-suffice.statement:
Single-source morphisms suffice because the shared given variables do the
remaining work of the correspondence.

pic-morph-relational-breaks.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-morph-relational-breaks.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-condense-dd/udt-condense-dd-findings.md,
item 6 (the correspondence needs perfect condensation of both models, a
hypothesis that relaxed morphisms can break).
pic-morph-relational-breaks.statement:
Morphisms more general than single-source maps are needed, and the
correspondence theorems fail under them, so Stage 4 builds a new theory of the
same concept rather than analyzing Eisenstat's.

pic-morph-relational-survives.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-morph-relational-survives.source:
AI reading of the roadmap's Stage 4 sentence on the notion of function involved
(projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md); the condensation
paper's morphisms are single-source.
pic-morph-relational-survives.statement:
Morphisms more general than single-source maps are needed to carry the same
concept, and the correspondence theorems survive under them.

pic-morph-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-morph-residual.statement:
None of the three: some other relation between the morphism notion and the same
concept holds.

pic-obj-conditioning.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-conditioning.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static, the
proposal P2 (conditioning on the legitimacy event).
pic-obj-conditioning.statement:
The objective is the expected future legitimate evaluation conditional on the
legitimacy event.

pic-obj-decomposition.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-decomposition.statement:
The objective is the cross-branch decomposition: the agent supplies branch
weights and the legitimate humans supply branch-conditional counterfactual
assessments of each action.

pic-obj-floor.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-floor.statement:
The objective is the activated security: the future legitimate evaluation
multiplied by the legitimacy indicator, with floor zero on illegitimate worlds.

pic-obj-graded.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-graded.source:
AI reading: a graded alternative to the activated security's floor
(PRIORITIES.md, the activated security); the proposal P3 of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static.
pic-obj-graded.statement:
The objective is graded: illegitimate worlds are scored by a graded value
rather than by a floor, so that violations count as worse without being
uniformly the worst.

pic-obj-lexical-gap.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-lexical-gap.source:
wiki/Corrigibility.md, section 5, Box 3; the proposals P4a and P4b of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static.
pic-obj-lexical-gap.statement:
The objective ranks every illegitimate outcome below every legitimate one,
lexically or by a cardinal gap, so that the best illegitimate world is worse
than the worst legitimate world.

pic-obj-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-obj-residual.notes: The residual row; its weight is derived as the remainder.
pic-obj-residual.source:
The residual of the table; a committed rule term charged on tainted branches is
one example (AI reading).
pic-obj-residual.statement:
The objective is of a shape none of the five proposals has, such as a committed
rule term charged on tainted branches.

pic-object-dynamic.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-object-dynamic.source: AI reading of the coalition setting; no public source.
pic-object-dynamic.statement:
The intended object is a dynamic aggregate of learning members, where a weight
law is the first theorem needed and every lying, secrecy and detection question
has content.

pic-object-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-object-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.

pic-object-static.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-object-static.source:
AI reading: Critch's published recursion for Pareto-optimal agents serving
several principals, with priors fixed at time zero.
pic-object-static.statement:
The intended object is Critch's recursion as written, with priors fixed at time
zero and deference as a choice of prior.

pic-order-floor.author: @smithy-verity
pic-order-floor.statement:
Every illegitimate world scores the minimum allowed value, so the floor is the
faithful scoring.

pic-order-graded-overlap.author: @smithy-verity
pic-order-graded-overlap.source:
AI reading: the graded alternative to the floor
(projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-08-legitimate-deference-consolidation/LEGITIMATE_DEFERENCE.md)
and to the lexical gap (wiki/Corrigibility.md, section 5, Box 3); the proposal
P3 of projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static.
pic-order-graded-overlap.statement:
Some illegitimate worlds are better than some legitimate ones, so a graded
cardinal scoring is the faithful rule.

pic-order-lexical-gap.author: @smithy-verity
pic-order-lexical-gap.source:
wiki/Corrigibility.md, section 5, Box 3; the proposals P4a and P4b of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static.
pic-order-lexical-gap.statement:
Every illegitimate world is worse than every legitimate one, with a gap, so
that a lexical or cardinal-gap rule is the faithful scoring.

pic-order-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-order-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-order-residual.statement:
The humans' ordering of illegitimate against legitimate worlds is one not among
the other pictures.

pic-pace-ai-assists.author: @smithy-verity
pic-pace-ai-assists.statement:
The AI's assistance improves the overseers' evaluation quality without
delegitimizing the channel, as an agent that wishes to maintain the legitimacy
of its modifications would.

pic-pace-falls-behind.author: @smithy-verity
pic-pace-falls-behind.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-trajectory, finding
F-13; reading the replacement kernels nearest to current practice as falling
behind is an AI reading.
pic-pace-falls-behind.statement:
The overseers' evaluation quality falls behind the agent's capability under the
replacement kernels nearest to current practice.

pic-pace-human-improves.author: @smithy-verity
pic-pace-human-improves.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.3 (the implicit assumption of the li-deference work).
pic-pace-human-improves.statement:
The overseers' evaluation quality improves along with the AI through the
humans' own efforts, without the AI's assistance.

pic-pace-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-pace-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-pace-residual.statement: Oversight keeps pace, or fails to, by a mechanism not among the other pictures.

pic-partial-updatelessness.author: @smithy-verity
pic-partial-updatelessness.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-endorse-policy/udt-endorse-policy-report.md
(decisionFlat_iff) and
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-bli-core/udt-bli-core-report.md
(oneStep_iff_updateful): the finite theorems whose shape is updateful across
cells, updateless within;
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-bli-tiling/udt-bli-tiling-report.md,
the re-freezing dilemma.
pic-partial-updatelessness.statement:
Only a restricted updatelessness is available, updateful across some partition
and updateless within its cells or decaying over time, and it supports a weaker
tiling statement than the claim asks for.

pic-predicted-ai.author: @smithy-verity
pic-predicted-ai.notes:
Also a scope limit of the updateful plan: the same sentences say the updateful
theorem's scope condition excludes exactly the problems where updateless
reasoning matters.
pic-predicted-ai.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, open problem
Decision theory: "it does not seek to model the decision-theoretic consequences
of environments containing powerful predictors, and it ignores updatelessness."
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/open-problems.md, Research
direction: trust the policy, not the decision rule: "no decision rule is
optimal across all embedded environments (Death in Damascus and Counterfactual
Mugging are both in the family the scope condition excludes)."
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness: "total trust and deference come apart when actions can
have acausal consequences".
pic-predicted-ai.statement:
AI systems are predicted, simulated and selected on their policies by their
developers, so human–AI situations have Newcomb-like structure, and trust
theorems stated updatefully mis-describe them.

pic-rs-partly-human-side.author: @smithy-verity
pic-rs-partly-human-side.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3 (the
channel-side cases: corrupt feedback, wireheading); wiki/Legitimacy.md (the
human-side definition). The division is the filing session's reading.
pic-rs-partly-human-side.statement:
Reasons cover the human side of legitimacy, deliberation, and not the channel
side, feedback corruption and wireheading, which the logical-induction line
handles without a theory of reasons.

pic-rs-reason-factorization.author: @smithy-verity
pic-rs-reason-factorization.source:
wiki/Legitimacy.md, section "Legitimacy has two halves": "Internal legitimacy
is factorization within the trajectory: all change factors through the
normative reasons."
pic-rs-reason-factorization.statement:
Legitimacy is a matter of reasons: internal legitimacy is factorization of all
change through the normative reasons, so understanding reasons is understanding
half of legitimacy by definition.

pic-rs-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-rs-residual.source: The residual of the crux reasons-subcase-of-legitimacy; no source names it.
pic-rs-residual.statement:
The relation between legitimacy and reasons is of a kind none of the three rows
names.

pic-rs-separate-interest.author: @smithy-verity
pic-rs-separate-interest.source:
AI reading: the alternative to the reasons-as-legitimacy reading of the crux;
no public source.
pic-rs-separate-interest.statement:
Legitimacy is a trust-gate condition on a channel and reasons are a separate
interest, so the study of Brandom's account of reasons stands apart from the
legitimacy programme rather than as a child of it.

pic-s1-errors-in-intended-statements.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s1-errors-in-intended-statements.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/DIGEST.md, item 14 (the
self-expert: the corpus's negative conjectures refuted on FAF's inductor) and
its table of note claims the Lean refutes (among them unconditional argmax
Value for the self-expert and Mart implies Value).
pic-s1-errors-in-intended-statements.statement:
The clean-room refutations inside the li-deference cluster are mostly errors
in the intended statements, and reviewing the cluster is a separate activity
from reading the Lean verdicts.

pic-s1-repair-is-the-review.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s1-repair-is-the-review.notes:
A reading of the formalization as a part of the review rather than a rival
to it.
pic-s1-repair-is-the-review.source:
AI reading; projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/README.md: "Everything
here is AI-generated (Claude Fable 5.1 agents) and has not been vetted by the
author."
pic-s1-repair-is-the-review.statement:
Reading the repaired clean-room verdicts against the corrected notes is the
review of the li-deference cluster, so the write-up follows the repair
whichever kind the refutations are.

pic-s1-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s1-residual.source:
The residual row of crux-formalize-before-write-up: every reading outside the
table's other pictures.
pic-s1-residual.statement:
The order of formalization and write-up is decided by something outside the
three other pictures, such as the publication form chosen or an external
schedule.

pic-s1-unintended-construals.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s1-unintended-construals.statement:
The clean-room refutations inside the li-deference cluster mostly concern
unintended readings of the notes, and reviewing the cluster is a separate
activity from reading the Lean verdicts.

pic-s5dt-identification-only.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s5dt-identification-only.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/project-status.md,
The Verified Chain: the checked chain from decision-determination to policy
utility to UDT runs in a fixed probability space, with agency attribution as
its first link.
pic-s5dt-identification-only.statement:
Decision theory stays in the decision-problems formal core's own setting, and
the Stage 5 object supplies only the identification of which systems are
agents.

pic-s5dt-logical-uncertainty-blocks.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s5dt-logical-uncertainty-blocks.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§15 item 9: "Under logical uncertainty, this fails: the agent may be uncertain
about which computation it is. Extending the framework to handle logical
uncertainty in the world-model itself is the central remaining challenge for a
fully general heterogeneous UDT."
pic-s5dt-logical-uncertainty-blocks.statement:
Logical uncertainty in the world-model defeats both the Stage 5 setting and the
formal core's, so neither covers decision points with differing world-concepts.

pic-s5dt-q7-home.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s5dt-q7-home.source:
projects/decision-theory/decision-problems-note-dump-2026-10-01/decision-problems-v2.md,
Q7 (per-state algebras with translation maps; ontological crises).
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§15 item 7: "How should the utility function transform under ontological
shifts?"
pic-s5dt-q7-home.statement:
Decision theory set over the Stage 5 object answers the formal core's question
of per-state algebras with translation maps, so decision points with differing
world-concepts are covered there.

pic-s5dt-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s5dt-residual.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 6 ("has a claim
to being"), the hedge every reading leaves room under.
pic-s5dt-residual.statement:
None of the three readings: some other relation holds between the Stage 5
object and decision theory.

pic-s6-live-conversations.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s6-live-conversations.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/ (the record of a
human-led conversation on corrigibility, released 2026-10-01).
pic-s6-live-conversations.statement:
Where a human-led conversation on a line of the agenda is live, a
researcher-hour of generating within it settles more claims than an hour of
reading older drafts.

pic-s6-residual.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s6-residual.source:
The residual row of crux-vetting-or-generation: every reading outside the
table's other pictures.
pic-s6-residual.statement:
What settles claims fastest is set by something outside the three other
pictures, such as a collaborator's review or an external deadline.

pic-s6-unvetted-stock-dominates.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s6-unvetted-stock-dominates.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/README.md: "Everything here is
AI-generated (Claude Fable 5.1 agents) and has not been vetted by the author."
pic-s6-unvetted-stock-dominates.statement:
The stock of unvetted drafts is large enough that a researcher-hour of reading
settles more claims than a researcher-hour of generating.

pic-s6-vetting-is-redrafting.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-s6-vetting-is-redrafting.statement:
Reading a draft and redrafting it are one activity whose output is a revised
unvetted draft, so hours of reading and hours of generating are not separable.

pic-safeguard-tiling.author: @smithy-verity
pic-safeguard-tiling.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/overleaf-final-source/main.tex,
section Tiling & Trust: "we must also ensure that it will not be motivated to
modify or remove safeguards, either through direct self-modification or through
manipulative influence over humans." The paper's positive results are for
versions of UDT (its Theorems 1–4).
pic-safeguard-tiling.statement:
Engineered systems that modify themselves or influence their successors keep
their safety properties only if their decision procedure is reflectively
stable, and the reflectively stable procedures in the known results are
updateless.

pic-sfp-all-corruption.author: @smithy-verity
pic-sfp-all-corruption.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__c1ab54d9.md,
turn 17 ("why should we expect all cases of harmful self-fulfilling prophecies
to have such a structure? Big if true!").
pic-sfp-all-corruption.statement:
Every harmful self-fulfilling prophecy has the map-territory structure of
corruption: the prediction alters the territory it describes, as money is part
of the map in a bank run.

pic-sfp-by-policy.author: @smithy-verity
pic-sfp-by-policy.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__c1ab54d9.md,
turn 17: "I'd rather believe an oracle that also optimizes for good outcomes!
Isn't it rational to treat bad self-fulfilling prophecies as corrupt?"
pic-sfp-by-policy.statement:
Harmful self-fulfilling prophecies are treated as corrupt by policy, because
one would rather believe an oracle that also optimizes for the outcomes the
believer values.

pic-sfp-nonagentic-predictor.author: @smithy-verity
pic-sfp-nonagentic-predictor.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__c1ab54d9.md,
turn 17: "perhaps there can be a legitimate thing that is not agentic, which
could cause some bad self-fulfilling prophecies but does not optimize for bad
outcomes, nor good outcomes."
pic-sfp-nonagentic-predictor.statement:
A legitimate predictor that optimizes for nothing can still produce harmful
self-fulfilling prophecies, so they are a separate failure from corruption.

pic-sfp-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-sfp-residual.source:
The residual of the crux self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption; no source
names it.
pic-sfp-residual.statement:
The relation between harmful self-fulfilling prophecies and corruption is of a
kind none of the three rows names.

pic-sharp-obstruction.author: @smithy-verity
pic-sharp-obstruction.notes:
None of the cited results is an impossibility for the claim as stated; each
kills one natural form.
pic-sharp-obstruction.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/soto-2023
(the 2023 impossibility-results and foundational-problem PDFs),
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-exactness/bli-exactness-report.md
(exact reflection fails on the diagonal liar) and
projects/decision-theory/rounds/2026-09-29-li-bria-synthesis-spec/PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md,
section 4 (P1').
pic-sharp-obstruction.statement:
A sharp impossibility theorem rules out every computationally uncertain UDT of
the claim's form over logical-induction-like processes.

pic-start-representation-first.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-start-representation-first.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 (the
representation theorem as the target; Dennett-style agency as what it amounts
to).
pic-start-representation-first.statement:
The representation theorem comes first, and Vingean agency is a corollary of
it.

pic-start-same-problem.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-start-same-problem.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/report/RESEARCH-REPORT.md,
row D11 (Vingean agency as quantified Blackwell dominance on an abstraction,
the conceptual root of the deferral model).
pic-start-same-problem.statement: The two are the same problem under two descriptions.

pic-start-vingean-first.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-start-vingean-first.statement:
Vingean agency is the test case the theory must capture, attacked first, and
the representation theorem is built to cover it.

pic-std-beauty-contest.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-beauty-contest.source: No public source; filed as a candidate standard for the crux.
pic-std-beauty-contest.statement:
The standard is internal to the community of legitimate reasoners: ground truth
as a Keynesian beauty contest that is nevertheless the reasoners' own contest.

pic-std-li-trust-principles.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-li-trust-principles.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3:
"Legitimacy needs to be defined as a direct modification of the LI versions of
Total Trust or Tower or Reflection".
pic-std-li-trust-principles.statement:
The standard comes from the trust principles of logical induction: legitimacy
is a direct modification of Total Trust, Tower or Reflection, and a
modification is legitimate when the gated principle endorses it.

pic-std-local-rules.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-local-rules.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 3;
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__f57f5f2d.md,
turn 5: "Just as truth-preservation cashes out as local rules, we want
legitimacy in general to do so".
pic-std-local-rules.statement:
The standard is procedural: local rules of sanity certify reasoning on
never-settled questions, as truth-preservation certifies deduction.

pic-std-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-residual.source: The residual of the crux internal-standard-never-settled; no source names it.
pic-std-residual.statement: The standard, if any, is of a kind none of the five rows names.

pic-std-second-channel.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-second-channel.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/legitimacy-theory-v1.md, section
8, item 7;
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-finite-defect/legit-finite-defect-report.md,
the detection target's transparency near-miss (the influence map separates the
two-system pair).
pic-std-second-channel.statement:
A second channel, an influence map in the record or mechanistic transparency,
detects endpoint movement and separates improvement from manipulation,
softening the speed-only thesis.

pic-std-speed-only.author: @smithy-verity
pic-std-speed-only.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/legitimacy-theory-v1.md, section
2.2, the block quote headed "Acceleration-only thesis".
pic-std-speed-only.statement:
No internal criterion exists: endpoint preservation, speed only, is the
definition, and any movement of the never-settled endpoint counts as
corruption.

pic-trained-policies.author: @smithy-verity
pic-trained-policies.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/open-problems.md, Research
direction: trust the policy, not the decision rule: "model an AI trained to act
— a policy the humans can trust directly — rather than an estimator run through
an argmax rule"; the landed question policy-level-total-trust. The picture
itself is the filing session's; the source cuts both ways, since training is
ex-ante policy selection.
pic-trained-policies.statement:
Engineered AI systems are trained policies whose decision theory is not a
design choice, so a theory of updatelessness changes no engineering decision.

pic-udt-full-needed.author: @smithy-verity
pic-udt-full-needed.source:
AI reading; the difficulty of combining updateless decision theory with logical
induction is the subject of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/notion-notes-for-soto-and-diff.md.
pic-udt-full-needed.statement:
Full updateless reasoning by the agent is needed for the caution, bringing with
it the difficulty of combining updateless decision theory with logical
induction.

pic-udt-learned-value-substitutes.author: @smithy-verity
pic-udt-learned-value-substitutes.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-dynamic: the
anger term D4_iii and the pattern row "the anger substitute relocates
updatelessness into the evaluators' values" of its findings file.
pic-udt-learned-value-substitutes.statement:
A learned human value for benefit to illegitimate worlds, as anger substitutes
for an updateless deterrence policy in humans, supplies the caution without the
agent reasoning updatelessly.

pic-udt-margin-reading.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-udt-margin-reading.notes:
Under this reading the claim holds beyond a margin proportional to δ and fails
at near ties.
pic-udt-margin-reading.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/03-journals/2026-03-26.md:
"it believes the _chosen_ policy = udt 1.1, not the _enacted_ policy"

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/uea-self-game/uea-self-game-findings.md:
"Theorem B and Theorem E are margin theorems"
pic-udt-margin-reading.statement:
The agent believes the chosen policy is UDT1.1 while knowing its enacted
actions may deviate, and the optimal policy beats every single deviation by a
margin.

pic-udt-narrow-suffices.author: @smithy-verity
pic-udt-narrow-suffices.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-pricing/legit-neg-pricing-findings.md,
the pattern row on narrow updatelessness; A6_positive_boundary in
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static;
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-dynamic,
family_threshold.
pic-udt-narrow-suffices.statement:
A narrow updatelessness with respect to the legitimacy event, statable as a
proposition about the day's belief state held fixed, supplies the caution.

pic-udt-pointwise-reading.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-udt-pointwise-reading.notes:
Under this reading the claim is refuted at two situations with loss 1 for
every δ (udt-trust-pointwise-refuted).
pic-udt-pointwise-reading.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/uea-self-game/uea-self-game-findings.md:
"Theorem A refutes the pointwise-EDT static-belief reading"
pic-udt-pointwise-reading.statement:
The agent's belief is a pointwise static belief over policies with an
evidential conditional at each situation, and 'believes its policy is UDT1.1'
means it assigns probability at least 1 − δ to the optimal policy.

pic-udt-residual.author: @smithy-verity
pic-udt-residual.source: The residual of the table; no source.
pic-udt-residual.statement:
The caution about illegitimate-world consequences comes from a mechanism not
among the other pictures.

pic-udt-residual-reading.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-udt-residual-reading.statement:
The intended reading is none of the pointwise, self-consistent or margin
readings.

pic-udt-self-consistent-reading.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
pic-udt-self-consistent-reading.notes: Under this reading the claim holds with ε = δ/(1 − δ) (udt-trust-repaired).
pic-udt-self-consistent-reading.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/uea-self-game/uea-self-game-findings.md:
"Theorem C is self-consistency plus the trust bound"
pic-udt-self-consistent-reading.statement:
The agent's belief is self-consistent: its policy is a fixed point of the
evidential best response under its own belief, and the trust bound holds at a
situation.

pic-updateless-value-learning.author: @smithy-verity
pic-updateless-value-learning.notes:
Compatible with pic-values-updateful if Geometric UDT counts as updateful about
values in the May 2026 sense; that is the overlap between the two pictures.
pic-updateless-value-learning.source:
Geometric UDT (LessWrong, 2025), cited in
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness; reading Geometric UDT as the design theory of value
learning is the filing session's.
pic-updateless-value-learning.statement:
The system one would build to learn and serve uncertain human values is an
updateless bargaining construction between value hypotheses, Geometric UDT or a
successor, so the updateless theory is the design theory of value learning.

pic-values-updateful.author: @smithy-verity
pic-values-updateful.notes:
The conjecture quoted above is filed as the shared claim
updateful-about-values; this picture is its consequence for the engineering
crux.
pic-values-updateful.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness: "My loose conjecture, based on my [Geometric
UDT](https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/Gmaq7vMj9NWLyQkEx/geometric-udt), is that
we should be more updateful about "moral uncertainty" (EG, an aligned AI should
be mostly/completely updateful about human values), while remaining updateless
about other matters."
pic-values-updateful.statement:
The uncertainty that matters most for alignment, uncertainty about human
values, is one an aligned AI treats updatefully, so updateless theory bears
only on empirical and logical matters with little engineering consequence.

pic-weak-pseudo-agent.author: @smithy-verity
pic-weak-pseudo-agent.source:
Grace 2022, "Counterarguments to the basic AI x-risk case": weak pseudo-agents
can raise the chance of an outcome without taking every effective opportunity
for it, and economic incentives do not clearly favour the maximizer end of the
spectrum.
pic-weak-pseudo-agent.statement:
The system has a single objective across the episode but raises the probability
of its outcomes without taking every effective opportunity for them, a
goal-directed non-maximizer.

pic-wrapper-coincide.author: @smithy-verity
pic-wrapper-coincide.source:
The proposals P4a and P4b (the lexical and gap orderings) of
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-neg-static; the

illegitimate below legitimate outcomes is the piecemeal rule stated as an
