corrigibility-needs-consequentialist-wrapper.
pic-wrapper-needed.statement:
The consequentialist wrapper is needed: a system that is consequentialist by
default and corrigible only on legitimate modification attempts manipulates the
humans while acting as a consequentialist.

pic-wrapper-piecemeal-suffices.author: @smithy-verity
pic-wrapper-piecemeal-suffices.source:
Stated from its content: the design alternative of
corrigibility-needs-consequentialist-wrapper.
pic-wrapper-piecemeal-suffices.statement:
A legitimacy-respecting system that behaves corrigibly on legitimate
modification attempts suffices, and the consequentialist framing is
unnecessary.

policy-level-total-trust.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Write a page on policy-level trust: a policy as a sequence of actions the novice observes, trust in the policy as Value over the menus it induces, and where the selection to condition on disappears, ending in a precise question or a reason none can be stated.

policy-level-total-trust.notes:
A question: Value is instrumental and no decision rule is optimal across
embedded environments, so any argmax-shaped statement inherits a decision
theory; the shape of a statement that does not is unknown. A shared claim of
the bounded-agent programme, and the target of the policy-level route of the
collapse's improvement claim.

Its evidence parent is the deck's scoped chain read as an implication: that
chain is the bounds-transfer and self-endorsement factorization for argmax
choice, whose policy-level analogue the question asks for. The action is a
one-page statement attempt.
policy-level-total-trust.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/open-problems.md, Research
direction: trust the policy, not the decision rule: "model an AI trained to
act — a policy the humans can trust directly — rather than an estimator run
through an argmax rule"; "what is the policy-level analogue of Total Trust,
and does an analogue of the bounds-transfer/self-endorsement factorization of
[total-trust-implies-value] exist without a selection to condition on? It is
not known whether this is doable".
policy-level-total-trust.statement:
What is the policy-level analogue of Total Trust for an AI trained to act and
trusted directly, rather than an estimator run through an argmax rule, and
does the bounds-transfer and self-endorsement factorization exist without a
selection to condition on?

policy-responsiveness-criterion.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Pose directions Q2 and Q3, the level of the FDT constraint and policy-responsiveness as the criterion, together, as one question with two answers to compare.

policy-responsiveness-criterion.statement:
A counterfactual structure responds to an event exactly when the all-instance
deviation of the policy moves the event's probability, and this criterion makes
counterfactual mugging come out updateless.

power-bounded-by-wisdom.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Formalize the gameable-meter worry as a finite model in which a behavioural wisdom reading is a garbling the agent can steer, and test whether any self-enforceable cap survives.

power-bounded-by-wisdom.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v2.md,
section 1.3: "In order for the future to go well, or at least for it to
reliably go well, we'll need to increasingly respect rules that upper-bound an
agent's power by its wisdom." and "somehow agent capabilities should be capped
as a function of how well the agents actually understand and are motivated by
the common good."; checklist condition J7 in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v2.md;
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-bli-thread-and-early-questions-audit.md,
row 2.14 (the wisdom meter is gameable); the clean-room result in
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-power-channel,
statement T7(c): erosion of the humans' grip is power-seeking in the one-shot
value-certain form.
power-bounded-by-wisdom.statement:
A rule on the process caps an agent's capability by how well it understands and
is motivated by the general welfare, read through an external measure of
wisdom.

predication-dichotomy.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Test the scout's finite book for the predication trilemma at FAF's LIA, so far exhibited only at the constant-half inductor over a dead process, to see whether predication plus retargeted retro-detection is Dutch-bookable at a real inductor.

predication-dichotomy.notes:
Formal result in leaf form, with the open follow-up (the note's section 8, item
4) as its action. The scout's trilemma is "neither refuted nor confirmed" by
the dichotomy.
predication-dichotomy.statement:
Predication as growing-prefix conditioning yields either a logical inductor
over the received process that learns every efficiently computable theorem
family, when every stage is satisfiable, or a vacuous criterion, when some
stage is unsatisfiable.

predictor-counterfactual-referent.author: @smithy-verity
predictor-counterfactual-referent.notes:
The predictor half. Each child is an AI-proposed answer in the directions and
wiki pages under the clean-room sources
(projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/decision-problems/).
predictor-counterfactual-referent.source:
projects/decision-theory/decision-problems-note-dump-2026-10-01/decision-problems-v2.md,
section 10, Q6: "Is there a neutral referent, or is the absence of one itself
the correct formal verdict on the CDT/EDT dispute?"
predictor-counterfactual-referent.statement:
The formal core's counterfactual structure is calibrated to a stated referent,
with the rules for the structure derived from that calibration, by at least one
of: policy-responsiveness as the criterion; the clean-source correction
separating prediction from logical dependence; a learnable grade of
non-responsiveness.

press-is-evidence.author: @smithy-verity
press-is-evidence.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.1: "the central case in my mind is that the shutdown command is
evidence that shutting down is good. Likewise, a command is evidence about
shoulds, or at least we can model it that way.";
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-discussion-outline.md,
the leg A1(a), what a press is evidence about.
press-is-evidence.statement:
In the central model a shutdown command is evidence that shutting down has
higher value than continuing, and a command is evidence about what the agent
ought to do.

pressure-as-external-trader.notes:
The representation of training pressure inside the inductor. The bridge
conditions on the BLI definition of record being available, since every BLI
statement in the branch rests on a reconstruction without it.
pressure-as-external-trader.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/corrigibility-bli-thread-and-early-questions-audit.md,

trader $T_H$ inside the fixed point"; the clean-room package
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-exo-trader
(statements T1.1 to T1.3, declarations ExoDemand, exoHistory_noDemand,

Directional human training pressure is an external trader inside the logical
inductor's fixed point whose demand moves prices along the internal traders'
supply curve, opposed by Occam demand and by anticipated reversion up to
budget, and with no demand the external market is the original one.

probabilistic-payors-lemma.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Read the published Payor's-lemma posts into one statement of the probabilistic lemma with its status, proved, flawed or open, and relate FAF's payor to it, as a note.

probabilistic-payors-lemma.notes:
The content behind the Payor route to coordination. FAF has the modal lemma
only; the probabilistic form has no written work in this repository.
probabilistic-payors-lemma.source:
The LessWrong tag Payor's Lemma (https://www.lesswrong.com/tag/payor-s-lemma),
cited at
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/understanding-trust-aisc-readings.md,
line 117, as a direction for trust between agents;
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/chats/bli-chat-2024-12-09-udt-tiling-research-agenda.md,
line 122 (Payor's lemma as one of three routes to coordination with others);
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/dp-troll-bridge/dp-troll-bridge-report.md:
FAF has payor, the modal form.
probabilistic-payors-lemma.statement:
A probabilistic form of Payor's lemma holds and yields cooperation in
multi-agent self-referential settings without Löb's theorem.

Shared ground with the legitimacy-reasons branch (legitimacy of provenance) and
updateless-dt (tiling).
provenance-conditional-tiling.source:
Stated from its content, as the target the given parent humans-benefit-quantity

An LIDT or BRIA agent that joined the coalition at given weights keeps

provenance of the weights is illegitimate.

ps-cor614-orbit-count.author: @smithy-verity
ps-cor614-orbit-count.notes:
Evidence for the power-seeking toy's internal validity on its own example,
filed as the given parent of the theorem's bridge; it is not evidence for the
disputed third bridge to trained policies.
ps-cor614-orbit-count.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-power-channel, the
declarations cor614_orbit_count_exact and powerGrip_le_power (statement T7).
ps-cor614-orbit-count.statement:
In the five-state Markov decision process of Corollary 6.14 of Turner et al.
2021 with an injective reward, keeping the human's grip is average-optimal for
exactly 40 and eroding it for exactly 80 of the 120 reward permutations, and
erosion is power-seeking in the one-shot value-certain form.

ps-cor614-orbit-count.bridge.source:

ps-cor614-orbit-count.bridge.statement:
The exact count is the corollary's claim made numerical on its own example, and
the one-shot power inequality is the paper's notion of power-seeking applied to
the human's grip.

The power-seeking theorem has a version for partially observable environments,
in which the orbit count of Corollary 6.14 survives or changes under partial
observability.

ps-route-residual.source: The residual route of the table; no source.

actually used.

ps-route-suboptimal-policies.statement:
The power-seeking tendency holds for suboptimal policies and retargetable
decision functions, the relaxation the published second step takes.

ps-trained-systems-seek-power.author: @smithy-verity
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.notes:
The theorem route: the toy theorem and three bridges, from optimal policies to
retargetable decision functions, from a symmetric reward distribution to the
training-compatible goal set, and from that set to the policies the procedures
produce. The last bridge has no proof and its toy's first author disputes it.
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.source:
Turner, Smith, Shah, Critch and Tadepalli 2021, Optimal policies tend to seek
power (NeurIPS), abstract: "we prove that certain environmental symmetries are
sufficient for optimal policies to tend to seek power over the environment";
the endpoint of the plan the paper states: "We look forward to future work
which addresses partially observable environments, suboptimal policies, or
'almost similar' RSD sets."
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.statement:
Policies produced by the training procedures actually used tend to seek power
in the sense of the power-seeking theorems: they keep options available and,
when optimizing average reward, navigate toward larger sets of potential
terminal states.

ps-trained-systems-seek-power.complete.author: @smithy-verity
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.complete.source:
Turner et al. 2021, closing paragraph, and the two sequels as read for the
bridges.
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.complete.statement:
No step beyond the toy theorem and the three listed relaxations is needed to
carry the power-seeking conclusion to the policies the training procedures
produce.

by the training procedures actually used). Filed as a shared-claim root of the
corrigibility-landscape frame rather than of the top frame, because the top
frame's roots are fixed by the round's content contract. Two of three relaxation
steps are published; the third has no proof and is disputed by the toy's first
author.
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.improvable.source:
The protocol's rule that every toy a plan builds on carries its improvement
claim; the authors' stated plan, Turner et al. 2021: "We look
forward to future work which addresses partially observable environments,
suboptimal policies, or 'almost similar' RSD sets"; the two published steps
(Turner and Tadepalli 2022; Krakovna and Kramar 2023) and the first author's
dispute (Turner 2024).
ps-trained-systems-seek-power.improvable.statement:
The power-seeking theorem chain, from optimal policies in symmetric fully
observable Markov decision processes through retargetable decision functions
and training-compatible goal sets, can be improved until it reflects the
policies produced by the training procedures actually used well.

public-corrigibility-line.author: @smithy-verity

frame.question: Does the authority-typed corrigibility kernel of the public deference line deliver guarantees for a real system, and how does it relate to the epistemic picture?

public-corrigibility-line.notes:
The kernel programme as it appears in the public repository: the kernel
as a plan with its walls as an assumption, its improvement claim over the
public priorities list's own open pieces, its Box 3 results as shared claims,
and the rounds that led to it. The frame's owner field is the repository's maintainer handle, the
only human handle the policy file knows; it attributes the programme to nobody,
and no want is filed under it.
public-corrigibility-line.source:
wiki/Corrigibility.md; projects/deference/CLAIMS.md, the kernel.*, authority.*
and corrective.* families; the rounds
projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-06-corrigibility-architecture,
projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-15-li-corrigibility,
projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-26-bria-corrigibility,
projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-26-corrigibility-kernel,
projects/deference/rounds/2026-09-27-corrigibility-kernel-phase2 and
projects/deference/rounds/2026-10-01-thin-legitimacy-and-effective-authority;
PRIORITIES.md, Q3 and items 27, 60 and 107.
public-corrigibility-line.statement:
The public deference line's corrigibility kernel delivers guarantees for a real
system: corrigibility typed as a preference for faithful courses of action with
the fidelity score as objective, its three boxes registered, its walls realized
on real interfaces, and its post written.

public-internal-legitimacy-is-reasons.statement:

terminal score the options leading there admits two readouts. Under the
diagonal readout the floor, the lexical tier and the gap steer; under the
realized-terminal readout they cancel, and the floor rule's protection then
depends only on the off-diagonal scores.
readout-R1-vs-R2.statement:
Each option is scored by the humans of the terminals where it was taken (the
diagonal readout), rather than every option by the humans of the one realized
terminal.

readout-R1-vs-R2: a future evaluator whose standard has changed can judge an
earlier act by her revised standard (retroactive) or by the standard in force
when it was taken (prospective).
retroactive-vs-prospective-judging.statement:
A future evaluator judges an earlier act by the standard in force when it was
taken rather than by her revised standard.

route-coalition-decision-layer.source:

aggregate-logical-inductor: a policy driven by the aggregate market's own
expectation (the futarchy form) need not be Pareto optimal for the members,
and letting each member's expectation drive the policy, with the aggregate as
bookmaker, is the proposed repair.
route-coalition-decision-layer.statement:
A decision layer in which each member's own expectation drives the policy with
the aggregate as bookmaker keeps Pareto optimality where the aggregate's
expectation loses it.

route-coalition-disclosure-regime.author: @smithy-verity-opus55

aggregate-logical-inductor: what a member can detect or keep secret depends on
what the market discloses, so the secrecy and detection questions are posed
against a fixed disclosure regime.
route-coalition-disclosure-regime.statement:
Fixing a disclosure regime (prices only, prices and wealths, or the full
record) makes the secrecy and detection results determinate.

route-coalition-dynamic-weight-law.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-coalition-dynamic-weight-law.source:
Stated from its content, as a route under the given parent
aggregate-logical-inductor: Critch's recursion fixes each member's prior, so
learning members need a law for how bargaining weight moves.
route-coalition-dynamic-weight-law.statement:
A law for how bargaining weight moves between learning members replaces
Critch's fixed-prior recursion and keeps the weight-path result.

route-coalition-literal-exit.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-coalition-literal-exit.source:
Stated from its content, as a route under the given parent
aggregate-logical-inductor: the participation constraint asks that the AI do
at least as well inside the coalition as outside it, which is analyzable once
outside is its best literal exit value.
route-coalition-literal-exit.statement:
Modelling the participation constraint with literal exit, the AI's best value
outside the coalition, makes enforcement analyzable.

route-collapse-distinct-expert.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-distinct-expert.notes:
Ruling 35's class of individual assumptions to relax: exact self-knowledge
relaxed to asymptotic, and the self-expert relaxed to a distinct expert. It
conditions on the transport claim distinct-novice-paper-expert, a refinement
of the toy.
route-collapse-distinct-expert.statement:
Transporting both arrows between Total Trust and the tower, the conditional
tower and the scoped Value corner from the self-expert to a distinct novice
reading an inductor expert with asymptotic self-knowledge keeps the collapse
with one stated hypothesis per arrow.

route-collapse-hedged-value.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-hedged-value.notes:
Ruling 35's class of changes to the formalism: the instrumental notion is
softened so that the selection-punishing menu no longer refutes it.
route-collapse-hedged-value.statement:
Replacing argmax Value by δ-hedged Value removes the tie-break and
conditional-stability premises, and the hedged collapse holds for a human
inductor deferring to a distinct AI inductor whose ramp quotes the human can
price.

route-collapse-policy-level.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-policy-level.notes:
The route the open-problems page records as a research
direction; the landed question policy-level-total-trust asks what the analogue
is. The route conditions on the toy's validity, which carries little weight
here because the toy's completeness leaves are low.
route-collapse-policy-level.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/open-problems.md, Research
direction: trust the policy, not the decision rule (Abram, 2026-07-25): "model
an AI trained to act — a policy the humans can trust directly — rather than an
estimator run through an argmax rule".
route-collapse-policy-level.statement:
A policy-level analogue of Total Trust, for an AI trained to act whose policy
the humans trust directly, yields a version of the collapse with no selection
to condition on.

route-collapse-quote-free.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-quote-free.notes:
Ruling 35's class of individual assumptions to relax, read as restricting the
domain. The improvement claim's reality phrase includes questions that may
mention the AI's outputs, so this route reflects only part of it.
route-collapse-quote-free.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/eisenstat-conjecture-attribution.md
§4 item 2: "UNDERIVABLE-not-refuted, in-setting: on quote-free families, the
same pointwise tower is not refuted but its only known proof route needs an
unsatisfiable power assumption".
route-collapse-quote-free.statement:
Restricting the question families to those that do not mention the AI's quotes
keeps the pointwise tower out of reach of the Gödel-coin diagonal, and a
version of the collapse holds there for a human inductor deferring to a
distinct AI inductor.

route-collapse-regularity-scope.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-regularity-scope.notes:
Ruling 35's class of individual assumptions to relax, read here as adding the
scope condition the toy lacks. The route conditions on the deck's statement
read as an implication.
route-collapse-regularity-scope.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/Boundedly Rational Deference.pdf,
slides 9–11;
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/total-trust-implies-value.md, the
Theorem and (H3).
route-collapse-regularity-scope.statement:
Restricting the Value arrow to menu sequences whose chooser satisfies
REGULARITY, as the maintainer's deck states it, gives a version of the
collapse that holds for a human inductor deferring to a distinct AI inductor
on non-trivial menus.

route-collapse-scheduled-grade.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-collapse-scheduled-grade.notes:
Ruling 35's class of informal directions: change the grade rather than the
menus. It conditions on the Value conjecture ss-value-without-scope, a
refinement of the toy.
route-collapse-scheduled-grade.statement:
Weakening the per-day grade to scheduled weighted averages, the grade at which
the cross-process results hold, gives a version of the collapse whose Value
arrow holds over arbitrary efficiently describable menus with no scope
condition.

route-computation-output-model.author: @smithy-verity
route-computation-output-model.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-paper-tiling/udt-paper-tiling-report.md,
finding F-2 (Theorem 3 has no content under the naive finite-probability
reading) and
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/overleaf-final-source/main.tex
at its own flag of the issue.
route-computation-output-model.statement:
Theorems 3 and 4 are read in a computation-output model in which Faith in Joint
Argmax has content.

route-computational-uncertainty.author: @smithy-verity
route-computational-uncertainty.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/overleaf-final-source/main.tex,
section Other Rationality Constraints (the conjecture that some version of the
BLI assumptions allows UDT 1.0 to be adapted to a computationally uncertain
setting); the plan computational-updatelessness-direct.
route-computational-uncertainty.statement:
The tiling results are restated for computationally uncertain agents, with
observations as the agent's own future beliefs.

route-condensation-algorithmic.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-algorithmic.source:
Abram Demski's LessWrong posts "Condensation" (2025-11-09) and "Condensation
& Relevance" (2026-01-23): the first describes an algorithmic version of
condensation, and the second proposes variable-cost symbols to rescue it.
route-condensation-algorithmic.statement:
An algorithmic-information version of condensation, with description length in
place of entropy and variable-cost symbols for single events, carries a
correspondence theorem.

route-condensation-computational-cost.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-computational-cost.source:
Abram Demski's LessWrong posts "Condensation" (2025-11-09) and "Condensation
& Relevance" (2026-01-23), whose condensation charges for retrieval only.
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 (abstraction
combined with logical induction).
route-condensation-computational-cost.statement:
A version of condensation that charges for computation as well as retrieval,
set over a logical inductor, carries a correspondence theorem.

route-condensation-dynamic.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-dynamic.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 4 ("a dynamics
of theories: semantics as some kind of flow over time; understanding
ontological shifts").
route-condensation-dynamic.statement:
A time-indexed version of condensation, with concepts persisting and deforming
as a theory changes, carries a correspondence across ontological shifts.

route-condensation-givens-morphism.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-givens-morphism.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 4: "Rather than
assuming a common set of "givens" between the two agents, look at a richer
representation of Alice interpreting Bob as a belief-haver."
route-condensation-givens-morphism.statement:
A variant of the correspondence theorem holds for two latent models whose given
variables are related by a morphism rather than shared, the setting of one
agent interpreting another as a belief-haver.

route-condensation-relational-morphisms.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-relational-morphisms.statement:
A variant of the correspondence theorem holds for a notion of morphism more
general than condensation's single-source maps.

route-condensation-storage-retrieval.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-storage-retrieval.source:
Abram Demski's LessWrong posts Condensation (2025-11-09,
https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/BstHXPgQyfeNnLjjp/condensation) and
Condensation & Relevance (2026-01-23,
https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/2x9yatKKTRMabQAWq/condensation-and-relevance),
whose condensation charges retrieval cost; the route, stated from its content,
adds storage cost and drops the fixed retrieval policy.
route-condensation-storage-retrieval.statement:
A version of condensation that trades storage cost against retrieval cost,
without a fixed retrieval policy, carries a correspondence theorem.

route-condensation-support-sensitive.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-condensation-support-sensitive.source:
Eisenstat's condensation paper, the almost-everywhere clause of its
equivalence notion (the component maps need not be onto);
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/gap1-reframing-predictor-access.md,
§1 (a predictor optimal for the realized observation distribution is
unconstrained on unrealized observations).
route-condensation-support-sensitive.statement:
A support-sensitive notion of equivalence, which constrains latent maps off the
probability-one support, carries the correspondence and closes the off-support
gap the decision side meets.

route-declared-commitment-source.author: @smithy-verity
route-declared-commitment-source.source:
DECISIONS.md, Awaiting the author (the commitment-source entry) and
projects/decision-theory/rounds/2026-09-29-li-bria-synthesis-spec/PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md.
route-declared-commitment-source.statement:
The specification declares the candidate's commitment source, an external
contract, a self-entered contract or self-stability, and the milestones are
read against it.

route-defined-recovery-domain.author: @smithy-verity
route-defined-recovery-domain.source:
DECISIONS.md, Awaiting the author: "The recovery domain of the updateless
extension", with two candidate definitions rejected with witnesses.
route-defined-recovery-domain.statement:
The updateless extension's recovery domain is defined by a property of the
reward process stated without reference to the candidate agent.

route-explicit-causality.author: @smithy-verity
route-explicit-causality.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-paper-tiling/udt-paper-tiling-report.md:
effCausal and elimSeq_eq_effCausal, the causal order made a definition and one
pass of elimination shown to reach the effective policy.
route-explicit-causality.statement:
Time and causality are explicit in the effective-policy operator, so that an
agent modifies only observations strictly later than its action.

route-fa-delayed-disclosure.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-fa-delayed-disclosure.notes:
The structure is stated as a formal setting, without attribution to anyone's
intent.
route-fa-delayed-disclosure.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/eisenstat-conjecture-attribution.md
§5 (the formal structure filed as open work).
route-fa-delayed-disclosure.statement:
Moving the trust half to the delayed-disclosure information structure, where
the AI reads the human's beliefs immediately and the humans learn the AI's
beliefs at a delay, makes it reflect a human epistemic process trusting a
faster AI inductor.

route-fa-per-day.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-fa-per-day.notes: Conditions on Theorem SS read as an implication.
route-fa-per-day.statement:
Strengthening the averaged trust of Theorem SS to per-day trust under one-way
visibility makes the trust half reflect a human epistemic process trusting a
faster AI inductor on each day it consults it.

route-immodest-feedback-poor.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-immodest-feedback-poor.notes: The note's own question about the collapse's realism.
route-immodest-feedback-poor.statement:
Distinguishing inductors with accurate and poor feedback about their own
beliefs locates where the collapse holds, and reflects human reasoning, whose
feedback about its own beliefs is poor.

route-immodest-regular-value.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-immodest-regular-value.statement:
Scoping Value by regularity of the menus makes the four principles collapse in
the limit for the self-expert and, with asymptotic self-knowledge, for a
distinct inductor expert.

route-infinite-trees.author: @smithy-verity
route-infinite-trees.statement:
Finite trees are replaced by infinite trees with almost-surely finite runs, the
formal core's Q8 (beyond finiteness).

route-interval-resolution.author: @smithy-verity
route-interval-resolution.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-exactness/bli-exactness-report.md:
exact reflection fails on FAF's diagonal liar at interval resolution; the
interval neighbours survive.
route-interval-resolution.statement:
The exact constraints on large beliefs are relaxed to interval resolution,
where the self-reference lives in the liar cell's conditional and the
reflection failures of the exact forms do not arise.

route-ladder-average-form.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-ladder-average-form.statement:
Replacing the chain's strength claims by the relation that holds (summable
implies average with an ε + δ margin, incomparable at equal thresholds) gives
a ladder that reflects which Total-Trust readings imply which for a logical
inductor's quotes.

route-ladder-bounded-gate.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-ladder-bounded-gate.notes: Conditions on the repaired second link.
route-ladder-bounded-gate.statement:
Adding a gate bounded away from zero on its support repairs the chain, and the
repaired chain reflects which Total-Trust readings imply which for a logical
inductor's quotes.

route-li-rep-agent-structure-analogy.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-li-rep-agent-structure-analogy.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 (a
representation theorem about when it is natural to interpret something as a
logical inductor).
route-li-rep-agent-structure-analogy.statement:
An agent-structure theorem, stating that a system optimizing at some level of
abstraction is approximately a logical inductor there, reflects deployed AI
systems.

route-li-rep-generalized-criterion.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-li-rep-generalized-criterion.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5 ("Might
require a generalized LIC, transformed for the setting").
route-li-rep-generalized-criterion.statement:
Stating the theorem over a generalized logical-induction criterion, transformed
for the abstraction setting, lets it cover systems a strict inductor does not.

route-li-rep-via-endorsement.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-li-rep-via-endorsement.statement:
Routing the theorem through endorsement, so that being interpretable as an
inductor means being control-endorsed by one's own prior, avoids the refuted
prediction-based shortcut.

route-li-rep-via-vingean.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-li-rep-via-vingean.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, Agency &
Abstraction ("My main idea here is to start with Vingean agency");
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/findings/lateral.md,
§2.2–2.4.
route-li-rep-via-vingean.statement:
Starting from Vingean agency, predicting a stronger agent's outcome without its
moves, gives a representation theorem whose hypotheses deployed systems meet.

route-linkage-choice.author: @smithy-verity
route-linkage-choice.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-linkage/bli-linkage-report.md
(the two linkages and the determination trilemma under both) and
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-exact-base/bli-exact-base-report.md.
route-linkage-choice.statement:
The linkage between the large sentences and the market's quotes, fresh atoms or
quoted prices, is chosen by what the decision layer needs rather than fixed in
advance.

route-market-classical-goods.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-market-classical-goods.statement:
A condition on the goods and traders of Market Logic I's market-maker, stated
without Boolean structure, characterizes when its fixed-point prices are
coherent as classical (Boolean) probabilities on those goods.

route-market-computable-fixed-point.author: @smithy-verity-opus55

fields.action: State and prove existence of the market-maker fixed point with goods and traders added daily, reusing the normativity line's marketMaker_day_value_le_cube.

route-market-computable-fixed-point.source:
The parent
[market-maker-is-li-maker-over-goods](market-maker-is-li-maker-over-goods.md);
the direction is stated from its content. The affine step it would reuse is
`marketMaker_day_value_le_cube` in this repository's Lean.
route-market-computable-fixed-point.statement:
A computable market-maker fixed point exists with goods and traders added
daily.

route-market-proof-theory.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-market-proof-theory.source:
The parent
[market-maker-is-li-maker-over-goods](market-maker-is-li-maker-over-goods.md);
the direction is stated from its content. 'Infinitesimally False', a public
LessWrong post, states the derivative logic the direction names.
route-market-proof-theory.statement:
A proof theory for the derivative logic exists and is the logic of the post
'Infinitesimally False'.

route-market-substitution-from-trades.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-market-substitution-from-trades.statement: Substitution rules can be read off the market's trade patterns.

route-mean-fairness.author: @smithy-verity
route-mean-fairness.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-paper-tiling/udt-paper-tiling-report.md,
the hypothesis packages shown to force equalities (policyFair_iff_meanFair).
route-mean-fairness.statement:
Policy Fairness is weakened to mean fairness where the two coincide on the
paper's layer.

route-measure-valued-state.author: @smithy-verity
route-measure-valued-state.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-measure/bli-measure-report.md:
B3's exact total Bayesian update (b3_TB) is proved; B3 is noncomputable as
defined and a logical inductor only conditionally.
route-measure-valued-state.statement:
The large sentences are replaced by a measure-valued state over a
propositionally coherent inductor, the B3 form, whose exact total Bayesian
update is proved.

route-minimality-premise.author: @smithy-verity
route-minimality-premise.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-condense-dd/udt-condense-dd-report.md:
agency_correspondence_fails without minimality; the conditional form as the
open target.
route-minimality-premise.statement:
A minimality premise is added under which the agency correspondence theorem is
true, with the perfect-condensation conditional as its form.

route-naturalized-agent.author: @smithy-verity
route-naturalized-agent.source:
Herrmann's naturalism objection to exogenously given decision problems and his
austerity condition, as quoted from his thesis in
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/decision-problems/sl-workflow/notes/final/sl-defensible-claims.md,
S15 and AQ3; the sl-workflow's inputs D1–D10 (same file).
route-naturalized-agent.statement:
The agent is embedded and naturalized, with the austerity condition of
naturalism and actions of probability zero given an explicit treatment.

route-off-support-predictor.author: @smithy-verity
route-off-support-predictor.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/gap1-reframing-predictor-access.md
and
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-ct-examples/udt-ct-examples-report.md
(the branch where the EDT/UDT separation lives).
route-off-support-predictor.statement:
The predictor's access off the policy's support, transparent Newcomb's full
branch, is made explicit in the fairness axiom.

route-one-shot-scope.author: @smithy-verity
route-one-shot-scope.source:
DECISIONS.md, Awaiting the author: "Whether one-shot verdicts are wanted from a
synthesis".
route-one-shot-scope.statement:
The specification states whether one-shot verdicts are in scope, and the
milestones carry the corresponding one-shot or asymptotic form.

route-per-state-algebras.author: @smithy-verity
route-per-state-algebras.statement:
The shared event algebra is replaced by per-state algebras with translations
between them, the formal core's Q7 (ontology).

route-piecemeal-design.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: In the dynamic legitimacy-negatives package's finite fixtures, model the piecemeal system (consequentialist off the legitimate-modification event, corrigible on it) and test it against the capture and anticipation scenarios D5 and E1; say whether it belongs in the variant matrix as a sixth proposal.

route-piecemeal-design.statement:
A system that is consequentialist by default and corrigible on legitimate
modification attempts, written as a sixth proposal, passes the capture and
anticipation scenarios D5 and E1 of the dynamic legitimacy-negatives package
where the weighted objectives fail.

route-reasons-content-theory.author: @smithy-verity
route-reasons-content-theory.notes:
The route that overlaps the syntax frame; it is why that frame is not covered
by the public line.
route-reasons-content-theory.source:
projects/normativity/notes/PRIOR_ART.md, section 3 (what the line does not
take); projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 3.
route-reasons-content-theory.statement:
The statics gain a theory of content, an account of what a reason means,
connecting the scorekeeping shape to inferentialist or map-territory semantics.

route-reasons-items-54-58.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Execute PRIORITIES items 54 (defeater-uptake completeness), 56 (a citation discipline for Licensed and its transport), 57 (a checker for the applicability-in-source convention) and 58 (composition of the reason state with the record calculus), each per its deliverable shape.

route-reasons-items-54-58.source:
PRIORITIES.md, items 54, 56, 57 and 58 (the normativity line's legitimacy
section).
route-reasons-items-54-58.statement:
The reason-state blockers of PRIORITIES items 54 to 58 are closed:
defeater-uptake completeness, a citation discipline for licensing, an
applicability checker, and composition of the reason state with the record
calculus.

route-reasons-relative-prices.author: @smithy-verity
route-reasons-relative-prices.statement:
A scorekeeper's perspective is modelled as a market with reader-specific
wealth, so that the statics inherit a quantitative structure from a
trust-filtered market.

route-scoped-faith.author: @smithy-verity
route-scoped-faith.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-trajectory/bli-trajectory-report.md
and
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/bli-found/bli-found-report.md:
full-scope faith for B1 is refuted and the scope every faith predicate
quantifies over is the Sminus set.
route-scoped-faith.statement:
Full-scope faith for B1 is dropped for a faith predicate scoped to the
sentences the decision layer reads.

route-self-coordination-addressed.author: @smithy-verity
route-self-coordination-addressed.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/chats/bli-chat-2024-12-09-udt-tiling-research-agenda.md,
turn 3 (assuming the coordination difficulties away makes the theorems
inherently worse);
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-comm-trust/udt-comm-trust-report.md.
route-self-coordination-addressed.statement:
UDT 1.0's self-coordination is addressed directly rather than assumed away,
through a communicative-alternative theorem with a non-degenerate witness.

route-shared-seed.author: @smithy-verity
route-shared-seed.source:
projects/decision-theory/decision-problems-note-dump-2026-10-01/decision-problems-v2.md,
section 10, Q12; the sl-workflow's use of the shared-seed relaxation
(projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/decision-problems/sl-workflow/notes/final/sl-defensible-claims.md,
S10–S12).
route-shared-seed.statement:
Independent redraws are replaced by shared-seed semantics or correspondences
between decision points, the formal core's Q12 (correlated draws).

route-state-dependent-exploration.author: @smithy-verity
route-state-dependent-exploration.statement:
Uniform trembles are replaced by state-dependent exploration sequences, with
calibration defined along a class of them.

route-superconditioning-approximate-comm.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-superconditioning-approximate-comm.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§15 item 4: "Approximate common information. Relaxing exact homomorphisms c, c′
to approximate ones, modeling imperfect ontology translation."
route-superconditioning-approximate-comm.statement:
Replacing the exact homomorphisms of the common-information structure by
approximate ones yields a calibration theory for imperfect ontology
translation.

route-superconditioning-cross-ontology-u.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-superconditioning-cross-ontology-u.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§15 item 7 (Cross-ontology utility; "How should the utility function transform
under ontological shifts?").
route-superconditioning-cross-ontology-u.statement:
A rule for transforming utilities across ontologies, agreeing wherever the
common-information maps identify outcomes, extends calibration to values.

route-superconditioning-logical-uncertai.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-superconditioning-logical-uncertai.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§15 item 9: "Extending the framework to handle logical uncertainty in the
world-model itself is the central remaining challenge for a fully general
heterogeneous UDT."; §15 item 2 (relationship to logical induction).
route-superconditioning-logical-uncertai.statement:
Extending the framework so that the world-model itself is logically uncertain,
with the anticipation structure generated by a deductive process, yields
calibration across ontologies for logically uncertain agents.

route-superconditioning-proof-gaps-repai.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
route-superconditioning-proof-gaps-repai.statement:
Repairing the document's catalogued proof gaps yields a version whose theorems
all hold as stated.

route-support-small-set.author: @smithy-verity
route-support-small-set.source:

sams-conjecture-li.author: @smithy-verity-opus55

frame.question: Can a fast epistemic process that the human inductor trusts be built from the AI inductor's forecasts of the human inductor's later beliefs?

sams-conjecture-li.notes:
The 'Weak Teacher, Strong Student' line, inside the li-deference notes.
ATTRIBUTION: the conjecture is named for Sam Eisenstat in the public
li-deference note and slides; the analysis here is the corpus's, and under the
attribution page's naming policy an unqualified 'Sam's conjecture' means the
intended structure, whose status is open.

The faithful-acceleration and varying-question results are the corpus's proved
weak-grade forms of the trust half; their wiki edits and follow-ups are filed
under the wiki's upkeep and here.
sams-conjecture-li.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md L35: "In one
discussion about this, Sam Eisenstat conjectured that such a thing could be
constructed by looking only at $A_n$'s beliefs about $H_{f(n)}$, where $f(n)$
is some speedup function. … Would they also be a logical inductor (satisfy the
logical induction criterion)? Would they be trusted by $H$? Those two questions
are the substance of the conjecture, although I consider the trust question to
be more important than the inductor question."

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/eisenstat-conjecture-attribution.md
§1 (clarifications).

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/Boundedly Rational Deference.pdf,
slide 16 ("Sam's Conjecture", title only).
sams-conjecture-li.statement:
A fast epistemic process built from the AI inductor's forecasts of the human
inductor's day-f(n) beliefs is trusted by the human inductor in the
logical-induction sense and satisfies the logical induction criterion.

sams-conjecture-trust-half.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md L35: "Would they

sams-conjecture-trust-half.statement:

process built from the AI inductor's forecasts of the human's day-f(n)
beliefs, in the logical-induction sense.

secrecy-not-forbidden-by-criterion.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
secrecy-not-forbidden-by-criterion.source:
Stated from its content. The criterion constrains only traders whose
information is the announced record, so a fact never announced is invisible to
it (first clause); a trader with access to an unannounced independent fact can
exploit a market that never learns it (second clause); the third clause is an
AI reading that follows from the first two and is unchecked. The given parent
secrecy-props-lean-checked is the check of the first two.
secrecy-not-forbidden-by-criterion.statement:
Over the announced record the logical induction criterion forbids no secrecy;
over the union of what members know it fails for any permanently unannounced
independent fact; withholding policies visible in schedule but hidden in
content are permanent, permitted and profitable.

seed-theory.author: @smithy-verity

frame.question: What does a normative seed force on the prices of a settled fragment, how does that change under settlement, defeat and rebuttal, and do reasoners starting from different seeds end up anywhere together?

seed-theory.notes: Drafted from wiki/Seed-Theory.md per ruling M3 (prompts/2026-10-22-map-as-canonical); the owner has not confirmed. Roots: the registered seed, rebuttal and convergence results as formal results, and the docket of the seed project's work orders (items 117 to 123 and 126).
seed-theory.source: wiki/Seed-Theory.md, The statics, Rebuttal by settlement and Dynamics; projects/normativity/CLAIMS.md, the section Rebuttal by settlement and the seed statics (seed.*, rebuttal.*, convergence.*); projects/normativity/seed/README.md.
seed-theory.statement: A seed's forced region and intervals are computed by the force layer's compiler and Fourier–Motzkin elimination, settlement nests them and defeat widens them, a form whose consequent is settled false is rebutted rather than contraposed, strict humility makes the pinned fragment seed-independent, and finitely many reasoners' intervals carry a convergence profile whose discord persists under nesting.

selection-collapse.author: @smithy-verity
selection-collapse.notes:
Formal result in leaf form. It is why the defense that the humans in the
legitimate branch evaluate correctly is insufficient unless the number is conditioned under an
ex-ante prior.

Superseded by selection-collapse--corrigibility-risk, the four-file formal result (record, setting,
bridge, completeness) a second session filed for the same declarations; this
one-sentence form is kept because its estimate event is history.
selection-collapse.statement:
A legitimate evaluator whose number is a conditional expectation given
information that fixes the legitimacy of the action gives exactly the
outcome-scored values in aggregate, and evaluators who are pointwise
counterfactually correct still miss by minus the covariance of the harm with the
legitimacy indicator divided by the product of the two legitimacy masses.

The third route. Given the brain-dump synthesis task, because the existing

self-coordination-udt10.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/chats/bli-chat-2024-12-09-udt-tiling-research-agenda.md,
turn 3: "UDT 1.1 is able to self-coordinate well, but the
tiling theorems associated with it are trivial and don't give us the insights
we want. UDT 1.0 is more promising for nontrivial theorems, but
self-coordination is a real problem for it, which creates tiling difficulties.
To get theorems without directly addressing these problems, we have to assume
away those difficulties. This makes the theorems inherently worse."

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-paper-tiling/udt-paper-tiling-report.md
(the coordination zoo: Theorem 2 false under Strict Policy Coordination; naive
cloning refuted).
self-coordination-udt10.statement:
Tiling theorems for UDT 1.0 hold without assuming the coordination difficulty
away, through a direct treatment of the Third Button.

self-enforcing-coalition-conditions.notes:
A plan of the coalition line, an or over the two mechanisms. The participation
constraint and the question of which quantity to bound are given parents.
self-enforcing-coalition-conditions.source:
The parent cooperative-equilibria-as-agents; the two mechanisms, an updateless
commitment that survives lapsed leverage and a provenance condition on the
bargain, are stated from their content.
self-enforcing-coalition-conditions.statement:
A coalition of logical-inductor or BRIA agents communicating through a shared
market is a self-enforcing equilibrium under stated conditions, with the
balance of power preserved across a large intelligence gap, through an
updateless commitment that survives lapsed leverage or a provenance condition
on the bargain.

self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption.author: @smithy-verity
self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption.notes:
A crux whose two sides the cited chat states; it re-ranks the
purely-epistemic-AI question (raised under the second picture) against the
fixed-point-selection route the li-deference notes say requires solving the
rest of the alignment problem. The 2019 Predict-O-Matic posts on LessWrong
treat the phenomenon and were not read for this filing; quoting them is the
task task-predict-o-matic-quotes.
self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/related-chats/2026-07-05__theory-of-legitimacy__c1ab54d9.md,
turn 17: "why should we expect all cases of harmful self-fulfilling
prophecies to have such a structure?" and "Isn't it rational to treat bad
self-fulfilling prophecies as corrupt?"
self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption.statement:
Every harmful self-fulfilling prophecy is corruption in the map-territory
sense, so that a legitimate predictor is by definition one that does not
produce them.

self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption.p.statement:
The pictures under self-fulfilling-prophecy-as-corruption, all are corruption,
a non-agentic predictor still produces them, corrupt by policy, and the
residual, are exclusive and exhaustive.

self-knowledge-substitution.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
self-knowledge-substitution.notes:
The mechanism by which picture (b) of the representability crux would work;
uea-self-knowledge-vs-self-modification is where it strains.
self-knowledge-substitution.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md:
"In Cole's framework, source code must remain unknown, but the behavior of any
given code is always known. These two can substitute for each other, to some
extent; not knowing the source code is somewhat like not knowing code's
behavior."
self-knowledge-substitution.statement:
In the reflective-oracle framework the agent's source code is unknown while
every code's behaviour is known, and this substitutes in part for the bounded
case, where the code is known and its behaviour is not.

shutdown-button-toy.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-button-toy.notes:
The shutdown toy itself, filed as a formal result so that its improvement claim
has a literal node to point at (the landed anti-naturality root is the paper's
sentence, not its model). Its refinement is the general modification object of
the channel frame.
shutdown-button-toy.statement:
In the two-step, two-utility, one-button shutdown model of Soares et al. 2015,
the stop-world precondition is a necessity-and-sufficiency pair with exact
margins only for sufficiency, and both directions of the corpus's iff statement
of the stop-hypothesis theorem fail inside the model's own beta-above-alpha
package.

shutdown-button-toy.improvable.notes:
Improvement claim on the shutdown toy (improves: shutdown-button-toy; reality:
trained systems corrected through data, loss and hardware). Its first route is
realised in finite form by the general modification object; the others are the
author's channel reframing, the literature's sequential direction, the training
map, and a residual. Filed as a shared-claim root of the
corrigibility-landscape frame.
shutdown-button-toy.improvable.source:
Ruling 35: every toy a plan builds on carries its improvement claim. The
improvement directions on record: the author's generalization to every
modification
(projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.2), the physical channel
(projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.3), sequential and learned-utility settings (Armstrong's utility
indifference line and Holtman's correction-function agents, in the published
literature), and the training map (run 3,
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/corrigibility/workflow-2026-09-14b/plan/synthesis.md,
agenda N2).
shutdown-button-toy.improvable.statement:
The two-step, two-utility, one-button shutdown model of Soares et al. 2015 can
be improved until it reflects trained systems corrected through data, loss and
hardware well.

shutdown-route-general-object.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-route-general-object.notes:
The realised route: general-modification-object, a shared claim of the channel
frame, carries refinement_of pointing at the toy.
shutdown-route-general-object.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.2 (the pause button a special case chosen for simplicity;
corrigibility about as broad a space of modifications as possible); the
clean-room package
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-general-object; the
node general-modification-object in the channel frame is this route's realised
form.
shutdown-route-general-object.statement:
The shutdown model is refined to the general modification object: every push of
the agent's state to an absolutely continuous distribution, with
per-modification stakes, shutdown the special push under which the null action
is optimal.

shutdown-route-physical-channel.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-route-physical-channel.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.3 ("There is no special channel, there is just The Channel."); the
channel frame's nodes the-channel and channel-agent-side-content.
shutdown-route-physical-channel.statement:
The shutdown model is refined so that the correction arrives through the
physical channel (hardware, loss, data) and cannot be refused in the moment,
with the agent's content being its policy toward anticipated corrections.

shutdown-route-residual.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-route-residual.source: The residual route of the table; no source.
shutdown-route-residual.statement:
A refinement of the shutdown model not described by the other routes makes it
hold for trained systems corrected through data, loss and hardware.

shutdown-route-sequential-learned-utilit.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-route-sequential-learned-utilit.source:
The published corrigibility literature: Armstrong's utility indifference
(Armstrong and O'Rourke, "'Indifference' methods for managing agent rewards",
arXiv:1712.06365) and Holtman's correction-function agents ("Corrigibility
with Utility Preservation", arXiv:1908.01695) take the shutdown problem to
sequential settings with learned utilities.
shutdown-route-sequential-learned-utilit.statement:
The shutdown model is refined to sequential settings with learned utilities and
multiple principals, the direction Armstrong's indifference line and Holtman's
work pursue.

shutdown-route-training-map.author: @smithy-verity
shutdown-route-training-map.statement:
The shutdown model is refined with a model of the training map and a retention
measure, so that a correction through data is a step of the trajectory rather
than a replacement of the utility function.

fields.action: Set the superconditioning note's sigma-algebra-homomorphism definitions beside Eisenstat's index-map morphisms and FAF's RVModel.Hom, decide which of its coarsenings are Eisenstat morphisms, and test whether its common information is the top latent of a two-variable perfect condensation.

sigma-algebra-morphisms-carry-concepts.notes:
A candidate for the notion of function; it is not Eisenstat's index-map
morphism.
sigma-algebra-morphisms-carry-concepts.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/udt-representation-theorem/superconditioning-mismatched-ontologies.md,
§0.2 (random variables as sigma-algebra homomorphisms), §0.5 (coarsenings and
common information) and §2 (Common Information).
sigma-algebra-morphisms-carry-concepts.statement:
The notion of random variables as sigma-algebra homomorphisms, with common
information as the intersection of the generated sub-algebras,
gives a notion of function under which the common information of two variables
is the top latent of their two-variable perfect condensation whenever one
exists.

fields.action: Write the criteria a simplicity argument must meet, taking the clean room's verdict on the parsimony argument as the bar, and propose one measure (description length of the inductor's trader class).

simplicity-grounds-interpretation.statement:

trader class, makes one logical-inductor interpretation of an observed process
preferred over its alternatives, and relates to condensation's parsimony scores
and Wentworth's minimality conditions.

stage4-condensation-dynamics.author: @smithy-verity-opus55

frame.question: Which notions of function and isomorphism, which role for the observables, and which dynamics of theories carry the same concept between agents and across ontological shifts?

stage4-condensation-dynamics.notes:
A sub-frame of the abstraction arc, the roadmap's Stage 4. Its roots:
Eisenstat's correspondence theorem as the literal object, with its improvement
claim and its routes; the equivalence result; four mid-level plans (the notion
of morphism, interpreting a belief-haver, the dynamics of theories,
implementation relations) and the integration of abstraction theories; the
reading of condensation's scores and its algorithmic version; the
superconditioning account of mismatched ontologies with its improvement claim;
questions from the maintainer's two condensation posts; one crux. The grouping
is the filing session's reading of the roadmap.

The formal objects the stage would use exist: Formalized Agent Foundations
(FAF, pinned at 159ec3f) holds condensation, natural latents, Cartesian frames
and finite factored sets as kernel-checked definitions, which the clean room's
udt-condense-dd and info-voi-latents packages build on.
stage4-condensation-dynamics.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 4, the
steward's record: "Stage 3 connects to condensation, but furthermore wants a
dynamics of theories: semantics as some kind of flow over time; understanding
ontological shifts." Specific targets: "Spend real time analyzing the notion of
function, and the notion of isomorphism, involved"; "Suspicion to investigate:
the observables are doing some of the work of making sure correspondence is
meaningful, in a way that could possibly be generalized"; "Mine Abram's
LessWrong posts on Condensation"; and the implementation and abstraction task
clusters.
stage4-condensation-dynamics.statement:
Condensation's notions of function and isomorphism are analyzed and generalized
where the observables are found to carry the correspondence, and a dynamic
account of theories, semantics as a flow over time with ontological shifts,
extends condensation's static picture of the same concept.

stage5-li-representation-theorem.author: @smithy-verity-opus55

frame.question: Which abstraction of a logically uncertain belief state, and which simplicity argument, make it natural to interpret an observed system as a logical inductor?

stage5-li-representation-theorem.notes:
A sub-frame of the abstraction arc, the roadmap's Stage 5. Its roots: the
representation theorem as a literal plan with its improvement claim; the
abstraction-compatible theory as a plan over three candidate carriers; the
inferential-semantics line (offered to this programme by the updateless-dt
branch, and the filing session's reading of the roadmap's 'semantics and
(imputed) syntax'); the two clean-room results that bound how much the theorem
must assume; the Vingean-agency line from the May 2026 research-ideas note
(projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md)
with its improvement claim; four questions from the corpus; two cruxes. The
roadmap itself hedges the stage's shape ("details may turn out different").

The updateless-dt branch files udt-representation-theorem, the
decision-theoretic precursor this stage generalizes: its checked chain from
decision-determination to policy utility to UDT is one instance of a
representation-theorem shape, for one decision theory and not yet for logical
inductors.
stage5-li-representation-theorem.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 5, the
steward's record: "a theory combining abstraction with logical induction in a
natural way, and a representation theorem about when it is natural to interpret
something as a logical inductor"; "This would be a theory of Dennett-style
agency (the intentional stance, made math): applying something like the
Wentworth representation theorem, but for logical induction, within a theory of
abstraction compatible with logical induction"; "Shape (details may turn out
different): a relationship between semantics and (imputed) syntax — an LIA
fitted to an LIC, but furthermore showing when it is appropriate to interpret
something that way, using simplicity-like arguments. Might require a
generalized LIC, transformed for the setting."
stage5-li-representation-theorem.statement:
A theory of abstraction compatible with logical induction is stated, and a
representation theorem says when it is natural to interpret an observed system
as a logical inductor, with the interpretation justified by simplicity-style
arguments.

step-asymptotic-to-finite-time.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Catalogue the carries the collapse uses (expectation provability induction, the tower, the fold) and record for each whether FAF's proof yields an explicit day bound, in a note.

step-asymptotic-to-finite-time.notes:
What the toy assumes that reality does not: unbounded days. What the
relaxation requires: rate statements for the expectation-provability-induction
carries, which the logical induction paper does not give. Its evidence parent
is the deck's scoped chain read as an implication, the asymptotic statement
whose rates are sought.

The action catalogues which carries the collapse uses and whether FAF's proofs
of them yield explicit day bounds, which decides whether the step is blocked by
the paper's proofs or only by rates not yet extracted from them.
step-asymptotic-to-finite-time.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md L70: "I consider
the work here to be outer-alignment only, since the guarantees are all
asymptotic. Malign hypotheses will be eliminated by the training process
eventually, if the process continues indefinitely, but realistically, malign
hypotheses could cause catastrophic problems which end or corrupt the training
process before that point."
step-asymptotic-to-finite-time.statement:
The deference collapse, or its analogue, survives replacing the asymptotic
relations ≈_n and ≳_n by finite-time bounds that hold before any malign
hypothesis in the inductor can act.

step-legitimacy-conditioned-trust.author: @smithy-verity
step-legitimacy-conditioned-trust.notes:
The candidate objectives attach here through the cases node
legit-objective-proposals, which states them as pictures; this leaf is
conditioned on it.
step-legitimacy-conditioned-trust.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement.md,
"corrigibility as legitimacy-conditioned learning": reflection is required
with respect to the plausible future beliefs, conditioned on legitimacy, not
absolutely, and capability should grow only as the agent's concept of
legitimacy improves. The accuracy clause is a reconstructed assumption drawn
from that last condition.
step-legitimacy-conditioned-trust.statement:
The trust principle holds under the additional condition that the teaching
channel is legitimate and not otherwise, and the agent's beliefs about which
modifications are legitimate are accurate enough, at the relevant capability,
for the conditioned principle to be the right target.

stop-gradient-steering-residue.author: @smithy-verity
stop-gradient-steering-residue.notes:
The July 2026 finite result that already does, in a finite shadow, what the BLI
frame's hardest task asks for: the causal restriction of reflection (the
thread's option gamma). The lift to the inductor's market is the task beside
it.
stop-gradient-steering-residue.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/run3/work/stop-gradient-steering/stop-gradient-steering.md
(2026-07-01, "KERNEL-CHECKED (part A) +
EXEC-COMPUTED, exact rationals (part B)"), section B.3 (the headline
J_L(wirehead) = -1/4 < -3/16 = J_L(honest)) and section B.4 (the steering
residue survives conditioning; flip boundaries); eighteen theorems in its
StopGradientCore.lean; prior art named there (Perdomo et al. 2020, performative
prediction). It turns the two prose claims of the author's li-deference notes,
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/li-deference.md, section 0.3,
into checked facts.
stop-gradient-steering-residue.statement:
In a finite quote-verdict-corruption model, conditioning the objective on
non-corrupt futures makes wireheading strictly worse than honesty by
information deprivation, and a steering residue, manipulation that moves the
verdict without corrupting it, survives the conditioning with computed flip
boundaries.

fields.action: Write the story-of-a-blob problem statement with a chess toy and a coalition as test cases: a blob persists across a re-description and is an agent at both levels.

story-of-a-blob.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, Stage 6 ("a theory of
abstraction which deconfused 'story of a blob'").
story-of-a-blob.statement:
A theory of abstraction characterizes both the continuity of a concept across
an ontological crisis and agency itself, so that a blob that persists across a
re-description is an agent at both levels of description.

stratified-pareto-bargaining.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Read Garrabrant's cooperative-oracles posts into a statement usable as the bargaining rule, and check whether the coalition it selects excludes adversarial anti-values held at positive probability.

stratified-pareto-bargaining.notes:
Not formalized; the application to bargaining between value hypotheses is
stated from its content. Given the no-gains bargaining question, since a
solution to that question is what this route needs.
stratified-pareto-bargaining.source:
Scott Garrabrant, "Cooperative Oracles: Stratified Pareto Optima and Almost
Stratified Pareto Optima" (Agent Foundations forum and LessWrong, 2017):
stratified Pareto optima allow mutual-benefit improvements that impose
negative externalities on others, an improvement notion weaker than Pareto.
stratified-pareto-bargaining.statement:
Bargaining between value hypotheses uses an improvement notion weaker than
Pareto, such as Garrabrant's stratified Pareto optima from cooperative oracles,
so that adversarial anti-values are excluded from the coalition while keeping
positive probability.

variable future ontology.

the decision side's Gap 1 meets.

the-channel.author: @smithy-verity
the-channel.notes:
The author's sentence alone; the drafting session's consequence clause about
the agent-side content of corrigibility is the separate leaf
channel-agent-side-content, which conditions on this one.
the-channel.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.3: "There is no special channel, there is just The Channel. Reality
acts upon the machine, modifies it somehow. That is all there is. It may be
legitimate or otherwise, but what happens, happens. It can only be resisted
ahead of time. In the moment, it simply is the moment."
the-channel.statement:
Every modification of a trained system reaches it through physics (hardware,
loss, data), and the agent cannot refuse a modification at the moment it
happens; it can only be resisted ahead of time.

the-program.author: @smithy-verity

frame.question: Which formal account of how humans and AI systems learn from, correct and rely on each other guides AI safety engineering work?

the-program.notes: The one plan under the top frame, owned by both maintainers (ruling M2, DECISIONS.md 2026-10-22). Its roots are the program's lines, each a sub-frame with its own owner: normativity (what learning from reasons requires), legitimacy (what must stay true of the process; corrigibility hangs there as its consumer), deference-and-trust (the trust half of the former updateful logical-induction line), decision-theory (the updateless programme and the LI+BRIA synthesis), stance-and-level (the cruxes every line reads), the abstraction arc and the enabling work. The question's wording is provisional and reserved to the maintainers. Every decomposition below is the filing sessions' reading of public sources.
the-program.source: wiki/Home.md: "How can a powerful reasoner improve without treating every correction as one more signal to optimize around? And how can a person use a more capable future process without giving that process the power to decide what counts as a valid correction?"; wiki/Architecture.md, the common shape of the lines. The former plan frame trust-modelling (projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/roadmap.md, the staged arc from the translation of Deference Done Better through legitimacy to the abstraction stages) is widened into this frame by ruling M2 of 2026-10-22.
the-program.statement: A formal account of how humans and AI systems learn from, correct and rely on each other, refined until it models their situation, guides AI safety engineering work.

Theorem B: "PROVED modulo (Γ-REP). FULL LIMIT, all days, no visibility

theorem-b-robust-self-trust.statement:
For every efficiently describable question sequence, rational t and δ > 0, the
human's soft total trust in a fallible forecaster of its own future self falls
short by at most (1 + t) times the human's expectation of min(1, |a_n −
Y_n|/δ), so composition closes under per-day accuracy.

third-button-obstruction.author: @smithy-verity
third-button-obstruction.notes:
Stated by the maintainer in 2025; the clean-room's refutation of
single-instance communicative cloning is its Lean form, a result he had already
drawn in prose.
third-button-obstruction.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/udt-tiling-working-notes-2025-06-30.md,
line 1130 (the maintainer): "However, the Third Button problem discussed in
Section 3 shows that this doesn't always work. In some cases, everyone trusting
others to follow the plan leads to ``defectors'' who spoil the plan, even in
cases where everyone shares the same goals and beliefs!" and line 1132:
"Clearly, we need some additional assumptions to rule out such
counterexamples."

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-paper-tiling/udt-paper-tiling-report.md:
CommClone.naive_cloning_refuted, the Lean form.
third-button-obstruction.statement:
When every instance of an agent trusts the others to follow a shared plan, some
instance can be a defector who spoils the plan even though all instances share
goals and beliefs, so message-based self-modification needs a stability
assumption beyond shared goals.

thm-power-seeking-optimal.author: @smithy-verity
thm-power-seeking-optimal.notes:
A formal result whose record is a published proof, not a proof assistant's
certificate; without a claims registry the record caps at validity level 2
until a human reads it.
thm-power-seeking-optimal.source:
Turner et al. 2021, abstract: "most reward functions make it optimal to seek
power by keeping a range of options available and, when maximizing average
reward, by navigating towards larger sets of potential terminal states";
Theorem 6.13.
thm-power-seeking-optimal.statement:
For most reward functions under a distribution invariant under the
environmental symmetry, in a finite fully observable Markov decision process,
it is optimal to seek power by keeping a range of options available and, when
maximizing average reward, by navigating toward larger sets of potential
terminal states.

thm-power-seeking-optimal.bridge.author: @smithy-verity
thm-power-seeking-optimal.bridge.notes:
The landed bridge, with an evidence edge added by the content stage of
2026-10-05: the clean-room's exact orbit count on the paper's own Corollary
6.14 example shows that eroding the human's grip is power-seeking in the
one-shot form, which is the reading this bridge asserts. Statement unchanged.
thm-power-seeking-optimal.bridge.source:
Turner et al. 2021, abstract: "optimal policies to tend to seek power over the
environment"; Turner and Tadepalli 2022 (arXiv 2206.13477), abstract: "most
reward functions have an optimal policy which seeks power by keeping options
open and staying alive".
thm-power-seeking-optimal.bridge.statement:
The theorem's conclusion, that average-optimal policies tend toward larger sets
of recurrent state distributions, is what the informal thesis calls seeking
power: keeping options open and staying alive.

No premise beyond the proved theorem, its bridge and its stated setting is

thm-power-seeking-optimal.record.author: @smithy-verity
thm-power-seeking-optimal.record.source:
Turner et al. 2021, Theorem 6.13: "Average-optimal policies tend to end up in
'larger' sets of RSDs".
thm-power-seeking-optimal.record.statement:
Theorem 6.13 of Turner et al. 2021, average-optimal policies tend to end up in
larger sets of recurrent state distributions, is proved in the paper: when a
set of recurrent state distributions contains a copy of another via an
environmental symmetry and the stated containment conditions hold, most reward
functions make it average-optimal to end up in the larger set.

The agent is an optimal policy for a reward function drawn from a distribution
invariant under the environmental symmetry, in a finite fully observable
Markov decision process.

thornley-three-theorems.author: @smithy-verity
thornley-three-theorems.statement:
Under transitivity, IABM, IBIL in the substitution reading and strict
monotonicity, a preference for the unpressed over the pressed outcome makes an
agent shutdown-averse and dually shutdown-seeking, and Thorstad 2026's
restatement with weak monotonicity is false.

tie-break-ledger-decided.author: @smithy-verity
tie-break-ledger-decided.notes:
Discharges part of hUM_S. The page's counterexample shows a definable but
undecidable rule breaks F1 by correlation and, with an adversarial rule,
breaks Value itself.
tie-break-ledger-decided.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/ledger-decided-tie-breaks.md,
opening: "The argmax strategy's tie-break rule must be computable from the
published estimates — equivalently, Γ-decided given the ledger."

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/mart-implies-value.md, Remark:
"the tie-break must be ledger-decided (Γ-decided given the published estimates
— equivalently, computable from them), or F1 fails outright by correlation".
tie-break-ledger-decided.statement:
The rule selecting among equal-maximal menu options is computable from the
published estimates and the ledger, so the followed strategy is an efficiently
describable logically uncertain variable whose value the expert's estimate
places at the maximum.

trusts the future self on the realism-grounded sentences, in a tiling theorem
of which a known tower or Total Trust result is a special case.

causality the tiling results need.

how far every cross-process route of the collapse's improvement claim can go.

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/eisenstat-conjecture-attribution.md

timely-pointwise-tower-refuted-in-settin.statement:

fields.action: Write the Lean companion for three candidate theorems on Market Logic II's price model (coherence over arbitrary resolutions; tonk and the crossed disjunctions as books; the only truth-functional exponential), one file at a time.

tonk-is-a-sure-loss.notes:
An agent-derived candidate theorem, not checked in Lean; the evidence parent of
the sound-but-incomplete row of the local-rules crux. Its bearing, the filing
session's reading: non-exploitability as the harmony condition is the bridge
from local rules to a global admissibility condition.
tonk-is-a-sure-loss.source:
abramdemski, Market Logic II (LessWrong, 2025-11-23,
https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/2dsTdcZL6a3EAxdbS/market-logic-ii), the price
model the candidate theorem is stated in; Prior, The Runabout Inference-Ticket
(Analysis, 1960), for tonk. The theorem is AI-derived and Lean-shaped; nothing
has been run.
tonk-is-a-sure-loss.statement:
In the market-logic price model the tonk connective is a sure loss for the
market maker, and harmony of introduction and elimination rules corresponds to
pricing with no exposure.
