The maintainer's claim, stated and not formalized; a scope limit the updateful
trust line can cite once it is a theorem, and evidence for the predicted-AI
picture of the engineering crux. The deference lab's copy of the same
paragraph,
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, replaces
'Total Trust' by 'Endorsement'; the May 2026 document is cited as the source
and the variant is noted.
total-trust-is-updateful.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness: "The notion of alignment as total trust appears to be
an updateful one; total trust and deference come apart when actions can have
acausal consequences, since a more-knowledgeable future self might refuse a
profitable counterfactual mugging, get the wrong answer in a transparent
newcomb, etc."
total-trust-is-updateful.statement:
Total Trust, the notion of alignment in Deference Done Better, is an updateful
notion: total trust and deference come apart when actions have acausal
consequences.

trace-nonrecoverability.author: @smithy-verity
trace-nonrecoverability.notes:
A formal result in the landed shape, finite version. The LI-register version is
the question trace-nonrecoverability-li. Its validity as an implication is
evidence for the picture of the local-rules crux under which no sound local
rule set exists (records cannot certify provenance).
trace-nonrecoverability.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/notes/legitimacy-theory-v1.md, section
2.3 ("Why legitimacy cannot be a trace condition"), whose provenance principle
says every safety-relevant boundary is a fact about "where a value came from";
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/legit-finite-defect/legit-finite-defect-report.md,
the declarations no_recovery and IdentifiedSet.defect_consistent_iff (the exact
identified set).
trace-nonrecoverability.statement:
No function of the observable trace is a legitimacy predicate: two valid finite
systems share a trace and have influence defects 0 and one half, and the
defects consistent with a trace form exactly the interval from 0 to the trace's
maximal defect.

legitimacy predicate: two systems sharing all data but the advised reasoner and
the siblings have defect identically zero and defect frequently at least delta.

An agreed claim shared with the landed finite-time step of the deference
programme (step-asymptotic-to-finite-time, filed by li-trust) and with the
trajectory packages.
trajectory-not-limit.source:
The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v2.md,
section 1.4: "we care more about conditions of the trajectory than where it
ends up. The formal model is going to have a limit point, but in reality we
think probably everything breaks down in the heat death of the universe if not
earlier. Properties of the limit point can be reassuring, but properties of the
dynamics more so." AGREED there with the drafting session's proposal.

The guarantees this line seeks are invariants of the joint agent-and-oversight
trajectory over finite time rather than properties of a limit point.

tt-implies-mart-gap-bets.notes:
The pictures are readings of the theorem's setting: the surrogate expert with
exact, provably linear expectations; the inductor expert with asymptotic
introspection; Total Trust granted only over parallel cuts of single bets; and
a residual.

The asymptotic-introspection row conditions on the repair
tt-mart-repair-via-bounds-transfer (a conditional table): its
conditional splits into the probability of the conclusion if the repair holds
and if it fails, so tracing the repair moves this row without a new picture.

The two independent verifications the page's status line reports were
wiki-level AI passes; they mint no level here, and no human has traced the
proof.
tt-implies-mart-gap-bets.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/total-trust-implies-mart.md,
Statement (mathematics rendered in plain text): "For an observable, coherent,
introspective expert, Total Trust over a gap-closed class D implies Mart on
D". Status: "PROVED (prose, this page) — verified independently twice at the
wiki level (2026-07-21)"; "not machine-checked".

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/deference-notions.md, Status:
"Total Trust ⇒ tower for gap-closed classes — PROVED (prose), unvetted".
tt-implies-mart-gap-bets.statement:
For an observable, coherent, introspective expert and a bet class D closed
under the gap construction Z ↦ Z − ⌜E*(Z)⌝ and under negation, Total Trust of
the novice in the expert over D implies Mart on D: for every Z in D, E^H_n(Z)
≈_n E^H_n(⌜E*(Z)⌝).

tt-mart-repair-via-bounds-transfer.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/wiki/total-trust-implies-mart.md,

available: the expert's own `loe` plus asymptotic introspection give
E^A_n(D_n) → 0, so E^A_n(±D_n) ≳_n 0, and Lemma 1 of
[total-trust-implies-value] applied twice at threshold 0 transfers both bounds
to the novice, giving E^H_n(D_n) ≈_n 0."
tt-mart-repair-via-bounds-transfer.statement:
With the expert's own linearity of expectation and asymptotic introspection,
E^A_n(D_n) → 0 and so E^A_n(±D_n) ≳_n 0; Lemma 1 of the Total Trust implies
Value page applied twice at threshold 0 transfers both bounds to the novice,
giving E^H_n(D_n) ≈_n 0, so the gap-bet theorem's conclusion holds for an
inductor expert without provable introspection and without the diagonalization
step.

reading, with the literature recalled and not checked.
turnstile-is-degree-preserving-lukasiewi.statement:

degree-preserving Łukasiewicz relation rather than Łukasiewicz consequence;
tonk is a sure loss for the maker; the two disjunctions are Girard's additive
and multiplicative pair; and the shared-context rules price 'if' as Gödel's
conditional.

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/chats/bli-chat-2024-12-09-udt-tiling-research-agenda.md,
turn 1 (the maintainer): "First, there are some basic things to fix or improve
about the UDT tiling results so far. I haven't accounted for time and causality
to my satisfaction. That is: an agent cannot meaningfully modify its policy
about the past, or about other branches of possibility that are not causally
downstream of the present. Only some forms of self-modification are even
possible. I haven't properly accounted for that." and "There are also other
things that can be improved about these basic results, probably."

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/overleaf-final-source/main.tex,

udt-tiling-foundations.statement:
The tiling results for expected-utility agents using versions of UDT account
for time and causality, so that an agent modifies only the parts of its policy
causally downstream of the present, by at least one of: the causal-order
formalization of the paper's theorems; a communication-based tiling theorem
with a non-degenerate witness; a direct treatment of UDT 1.0's
self-coordination.

uea-theorem-1.statement:
There is a reflective oracle relative to which, for every ε > 0, whenever the
self-reflective agent π_S assigns posterior above 1 − δ to its own
self-hypothesis at a history, its value at that history is within ε of the
optimal value, so π_S stays ε-optimal for all time with high probability.

uea-theorem-1.improvable.notes:

the issues the maintainer's review names: the self-knowledge premise rules out
rational self-modification, the theorem is updateful, and oracle calls are
modelled as independent so predictors are mishandled. The routes are his three
directions (self-knowledge split, updateless variant, correlation-allowing
oracles), the floored-agent repair the finite-shadow lab recommends, the
ε-exploration route of Kim and Lee's ε-asymptotic optimality result for
Self-AIXI (arXiv:2602.23242), and the residual route. Routes condition on the
theorem itself (a leaf) or on the refinement uea-floored-agent-theorem.

way reflective oracles do for logical induction, and where the analogy is
strained it can be improved.

updateful-about-values.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Set values_coin and the separability finding of udt-endorse-policy beside the loose conjecture, and state which of its two readings each bears on: value cells uncoupled in the utility, or a normative claim about aligned AI.

updateful-about-values.notes:
A loose conjecture, as the source states it. Evidence against its simplest reading:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/udt-endorse-policy's
values_coin (the mugging read as a values fact, where the values-updateful
policy loses) and its finding that 'values are separable' is not a property of
subject matter; with decisionFlat_iff the finite results say updatefulness
about values is optimal exactly when value cells are uncoupled in the utility,
a hypothesis about the problem. A third pass, the deference lab's critique
(projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/report/CRITIQUE.md),
rates the factual half near-trivial and the asymmetry a conjecture.
updateful-about-values.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness: "My loose conjecture, based on my [Geometric
UDT](https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/Gmaq7vMj9NWLyQkEx/geometric-udt), is that
we should be more updateful about "moral uncertainty" (EG, an aligned AI should
be mostly/completely updateful about human values), while remaining updateless
about other matters."
updateful-about-values.statement:
An agent's optimal treatment of uncertainty is updateful about moral
uncertainty, an aligned AI mostly or completely updateful about human values,
and updateless about other matters.

updateless-dt-programme.author: @smithy-verity

frame.question: Which decision theory for computationally uncertain agents on the updateless side is tractable, and which of its results bear on AI safety engineering?

updateless-dt-programme.notes:
A programme, filed as a sub-frame of the-program: a frame node whose
children are its own roots. Nine roots are the line's mid-level goals as plan
roots, each an `or` over the routes the repository's work takes toward it; the
decomposition into those nine is the filing session's reading of the public
decision-theory line and the May 2026 research ideas, not a list the maintainer
wrote. The shared-claim roots are theses stated in the public sources, the
finite theorems of the clean-room run that the plans build on, the cruxes that
live inside the line, and the improvement claim of each plan. The
two cruxes that re-rank this programme against the updateful plan,
li-updatelessness-tractable and updateless-engineering-value, are roots of
the-program, not of this frame, because the comparison they move is the
parent's. No want is filed for collaborators on this side. Classes,
the outside option and the undescribed-failure valuation are the top frame's.
updateless-dt-programme.source:
DECISIONS.md, the 2026-09-29 decision-theory entries (the maintainer's endpoint
for the LI/BRIA line: "updatelessness is an ideal extension"), and
projects/decision-theory/README.md, the public decision-theory line.

projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section Updatelessness.
updateless-dt-programme.statement:
A research programme on the updateless side develops decision theory for
computationally uncertain agents, counterfactuals, computational
updatelessness, decision problems, open-minded updatelessness and geometric
rationality, far enough to settle whether it is tractable and relevant to AI
safety engineering, and unfolds in full only where both hold.

updateless-engineering-value.author: @smithy-verity
updateless-engineering-value.notes:
A crux of the-program frame, stated in magnitude form. No
document in the repository has the engineering value of updatelessness as its
subject; the pictures are assembled from motivation paragraphs, the
maintainer's open-problem list, his May 2026 conjecture about values and his
2025 description of Geometric UDT, and the decomposition is the filing
session's. The four pictures that name a concrete engineering situation are
given the existence claim updateless-engineering-value-exists; the two pictures
against stand on their own. The May 2026 plan's sentence that updatelessness
need not be rushed is cited in the glosses as dated evidence. Re-ranks
updateless-dt-programme most, and through the corrigibility picture the
commitment-based corrigibility plans.

Not a duplicate of updateless-engineering-value-exists, the assumption leaf
beside it in the frame's list: that leaf says some engineering decision depends
on the stance; this table says how much the dependence is worth.
updateless-engineering-value.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/references/bli/understanding-trust/overleaf-final-source/main.tex,
section Tiling & Trust (the paper's motivation for reflective stability): "we
must also ensure that it will not be motivated to modify or remove safeguards,
either through direct self-modification or through manipulative influence over
humans."
updateless-engineering-value.statement:
The updateless side is high value to AI safety engineering work even where the
theory of computational updatelessness is easy: the engineering decisions
updateless reasoning changes are large enough that the programme's expected
contribution to a formal understanding of trust exceeds the updateful plan's at
equal cost.

At least one situation that arises between humans and AI systems, developers

updateless-p2-cellwise-p3.author: @smithy-verity
updateless-p2-cellwise-p3.notes:
Formal result in leaf form. It ties the conditioning objective, made
updateless, to the graded objective, and so the legitimacy step to the
updateless-dt branch's crux on how hard logical induction plus updatelessness
is.

Filed as a formal result (record, setting, bridge, completeness) in place of
the one-sentence step the branch filed: what the kernel settled is the
record, and what a human still checks is the bridge, whether the declaration
says what this sentence says. The step's estimate (smithy-verity-223)
stays in the ledger as history. The declaration is not in a claims
registry, so the record reads *not in a claims registry* until it is
registered.
updateless-p2-cellwise-p3.statement:
A cell policy is an updateless optimum of the conditioning objective if and
only if it has positive mass and prescribes at every cell the graded
objective's maximiser with illegitimate worlds scored at a fixed grade.

updateless-p2-cellwise-p3.bridge.author: @smithy-verity
updateless-p2-cellwise-p3.bridge.statement:
The declaration is the run's D2 (iii): a cell policy is optimal for updateless
conditioning iff at every cell it prescribes a maximiser of the graded
objective with that cell's multiplier, so updateless conditioning is cellwise
grading.

value-change-base-layer.source:

Value change is represented as belief change on an expanded algebra, the
murder-pill argument's hidden flat-utility assumption is exhibited, and the

value-change-is-belief-change.author: @smithy-verity
value-change-is-belief-change.notes:
The base layer of the corrigibility line: every later claim about corrections
as information rests on this transform. The derivation is the filing session's
(an AI's) at the author's request, with the fixture's numbers as witnesses; it
is unvetted against the fixture, and no Lean statement for it is cited here.
The Lean task is the plan root value-change-kernel-checked.
value-change-is-belief-change.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 2.1 (the transform, with Theorem 2.4) and the fixture
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/fixtures/value_change_journey.py,
run by the note dump's tests; the author's own statement of the idea in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement.md,
section 2.2: "I am non-realist about the distinction: this is just a
transformation in how we represent the agent."
value-change-is-belief-change.statement:
A change of an agent's utility function can be written as a change of belief
about a value variable on an expanded algebra, and the agent that results acts
identically on the original propositions; the direction from the expanded
algebra back to the original is marginalization and the converse is a choice of
decomposition that is not unique.

projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,

value-change-is-belief-change.improvable.statement:

value-change-three-terms.author: @smithy-verity
value-change-three-terms.source:

value-change-three-terms.statement:

term that is never positive (the murder-pill term), a payment term (intrinsic

positive only when the outcome of the change is uncertain).

value-uncertainty-is-computational.statement:
Human uncertainty about human values is to a substantial degree computational
uncertainty, uncertainty about the consequences of what one already accepts,
rather than only uncertainty about which world obtains.

The author,
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v2.md,

projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v2.md;

values-ahead-of-capability.statement:
For each action that becomes available at a step of the trajectory, the agent's
expected harm from that action exceeds its value of information before the
action is available.

fields.action: Build a two-world fixture in which the correction process installs the mixture state rather than the legitimacy-conditional state, and check whether the base-rate condition disappears as the note's section 2.6 predicts.

vc-route-hedged-installation.statement:
The correction process installs the mixture state, the agent's belief averaged
over whether the correction was legitimate, rather than the
legitimacy-conditioned state, so that the corrected agent keeps its doubt about
the correction's legitimacy and the base-rate condition on presses is not
needed.

vc-route-modest-source.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Write the exact relation between Total Trust without the martingale condition and the LI principle that no simple modification of the update is predictably better, as a theorem or a counterexample on a finite frame.

vc-route-modest-source.notes:
The route the note itself names first. The task is on this leaf: a theorem or a
finite counterexample settles it.
vc-route-modest-source.statement:
The representation of value change as belief change on an expanded algebra is
refined with a modest-source trust relation, that is Total Trust without the
martingale condition, whose relation to the logical-induction principle that no
simple modification of the update is predictably better is written out as a
theorem or a finite counterexample.

vc-route-modification-space.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: Attempt the clean-room's open statement universalSelfRefSpace_exists_open (the universal type space) or reduce it to a named gap in the mathematics library.

vc-route-modification-space.source:
The author in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement.md,
sections 2.2 and 2.4: "The main problem here, I think, is merely
representational: it is not obvious how to represent a Bayesian agent thinking
about all the possible ways it could be modified. We need to make assumptions
about the richness of the hypothesis space to rule out cases such as the
oscillation between opiates and stimulants." The clean-room package
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/packages/corr-reflect-frames lists
the open statement universalSelfRefSpace_exists_open.
vc-route-modification-space.statement:
A Bayesian agent that reasons about every way it could be modified is
represented by a belief space rich enough that the regress of modifications of
modifications closes, with a richness assumption that excludes the
impoverished-space case of Soares et al. 2015 section 1.

vc-route-outside-support.author: @smithy-verity

fields.action: State the convex-hull richness condition and the non-dogmatism assumption as one hypothesis, and show on the opiates-and-stimulants example of Soares et al. 2015 section 1 that it excludes the impoverished-space oscillation.

vc-route-outside-support.notes:

want-sigma-algebra-changes records that deferral in his words.
vc-route-outside-support.source:
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/value-change-as-epistemic-update.md,
section 7 (ii) and section 2.2 (the richness condition); the author in
projects/deference/corrigibility-note-dump-2026-10-01/position-statement-v3.md,
section 1.2: "In the current scope it seems most natural to consider any belief
updates meeting the conditions for superconditioning, ie, absolute continuity.
I also want to consider the possibility of sigma-algebra changes, which I think
is not so difficult to do, but perhaps we should study the case without
sigma-algebra changes thoroughly first."
vc-route-outside-support.statement:
The representation extends from belief changes absolutely continuous with the
current state to changes of the sigma-algebra, so that a value change toward a
target outside the convex hull of the prior's support is represented.

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/findings/lateral.md,

vingean-abstraction-candidate-definition.statement:
An abstraction of a system is Vingean-agentic when the latent that mediates its
behaviour's effect on an outcome variable is predictable while the behaviour
itself is not, and this holds of a strong chess player and fails of a
thermostat once menus vary.

vingean-agency-via-abstraction.author: @smithy-verity-opus55
vingean-agency-via-abstraction.notes:
A mid-level plan of Stage 5, an or over three candidate characterizations: the
maintainer's 2023 Meaning & Agency account (optimization as Vingean agency,
through endorsement), the deference lab's Blackwell-dominance sketch, and a
candidate definition tested on a chess toy. A task reconciling the three is the
given parent of the first and the last.
vingean-agency-via-abstraction.source:
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/AGENDA.md, Agency &
Abstraction (the maintainer, May 2026): "My main idea here is to start with
Vingean agency, by which I mean the sort of epistemic position we have when
watching someone who is more skilled than us at chess: we cannot predict
exactly what they will do, but we can predict that they will win. Can such a
thing be characterized well by a theory of abstraction?"
vingean-agency-via-abstraction.statement:
The epistemic position of predicting that a more skilled agent will win without
predicting its moves is characterized by a theory of abstraction.

predictability with fine unpredictability alone is not enough, as a thermostat
shows.

vingean-uncertainty-is-computational.source:

decision procedures to perform well on general principles, not by virtue of
being able to predict them precisely" and "the Vingean principle rules out

Vingean uncertainty, trusting a decision procedure to perform well on general
principles rather than by predicting it precisely, rules out computationally
omniscient models, so it is uncertainty about computations.

plan, which carries the priority word "high-priority" in his own text; no agent
sets the want's priority. The quoted words name legitimacy and corrigibility,
so the want sits in this frame; the corrigibility branch holds the
corrigibility reading of the same sentence. Connected by an evidence edge from
the clean room's definition of record for corrigibility as faithfulness plus
legitimacy on the governance questions.

either settles both.
want-corrigibility-theorems-via-legitima.source:
projects/deference/faf-cleanroom-2026-10-02/sources/unbounded-embedded/01-primary/summer-research-plan-2026--research-ideas-may-2026.md,
section "Modeling Legitimacy & Corrigibility": "I believe a good model of
legitimacy could also shed light on corrigibility: AI can be corrigible in
cases where it sees human shutdown/modification decisions as legitimate.
Formalizing this notion of corrigibility and proving some theorems about what
it can and cannot accomplish seems high-priority."

legitimacy-detection frame with an evidence edge from
legitimacy-conditioned-reflection@valid, folded into this one.
want-corrigibility-theorems-via-legitima.statement:
The legitimacy notion of corrigibility is formalized and theorems state what it
can and cannot accomplish.

The June 2026 toy: the first formalization of legitimacy-based corrigibility in
the repository, with Lean and a red-team verdict, cited by no September file.
Its relation to legitimacy-conditioned-reflection is unexamined (see
four-corrigibility-definitions); its headline rewrite is this leaf's action.

projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/models/legitimacy-corrigibility-model.md, section
0 ("central claim (PROVED, finite core;
SKETCHED as the LI lift)"), with the Lean declarations
LegitimacyCorrigibility.comply_iff_endorsed, endorsed_signal_complies,
adversarial_signal_resists and wirehead_declined in
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/lean/legitimacy-corrigibility.lean; the red team
projects/deference/note-dump-2026-08-11/deference-trust-lab/redteam/legitimacy-corrigibility-redteam.md
("VERDICT: SALVAGEABLE (the finite algebra is solid; the prose over-claims; one
fix needed)"); the thread is the author's May 2026 text at

wirehead-decline-toy.statement:
In a finite probability frame an agent that evaluates a future option by its
current endorsement, the legitimacy defect under day-zero prices, declines a
manipulation that raises future-reported utility, complies with a signal
exactly when it endorses the signal's process, and resists an adversarial
signal.
